rows.question: Show the details of rooms including the full name of the rooms, the building names, floor numbers, the organizations occupying them, name of the departments occupying them, and the percentage of the room area over the assignable floor area and building.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH floor_assignable_area AS (
  SELECT
    ff.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_ID,
    ff.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_ID,
    -- Prefer the floor's ASSIGNABLE_AREA if present, otherwise sum of room areas on that floor
    CASE
      WHEN ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NOT NULL AND ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA <> 0 THEN CAST(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))
      ELSE CAST(SUM(fr.AREA) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
    END AS SQFT_ASSIGNABLE_FLOOR
  FROM fac_floor ff
  LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = ff.BUILDING_KEY
    AND fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
  GROUP BY ff.FLOOR_KEY, ff.BUILDING_KEY, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA
),
building_assignable_area AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_ID,
    CAST(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS ASSIGNABLE_SQFT
  FROM fac_building fb
),
rooms_core AS (
  SELECT
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_ID,
    fr.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_ID,
    -- room area cleaned/cast to numeric
    CASE
      WHEN fr.AREA IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(CAST(fr.AREA AS CHAR)) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))
    END AS ROOM_AREA,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS OCCUPYING_ORGANIZATION,
    fr.DEPT_CODE AS OCCUPYING_DEPARTMENT,
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY AS ROOM_ID
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  WHERE fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  rc.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  -- return building name from fac_building (join to get human-friendly name)
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, rc.BUILDING_ID) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  rc.FLOOR_ID AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
  rc.OCCUPYING_ORGANIZATION AS OCCUPYING_ORGANIZATION,
  rc.OCCUPYING_DEPARTMENT AS OCCUPYING_DEPARTMENT,
  -- percentages computed and multiplied by 100
  CAST( (rc.ROOM_AREA / fa.SQFT_ASSIGNABLE_FLOOR) * 100 AS DECIMAL(9,2) ) AS PCT_OF_FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE,
  CAST( (rc.ROOM_AREA / ba.ASSIGNABLE_SQFT) * 100 AS DECIMAL(9,2) ) AS PCT_OF_BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE
FROM rooms_core rc
LEFT JOIN floor_assignable_area fa
  ON rc.FLOOR_ID = fa.FLOOR_ID
  AND rc.BUILDING_ID = fa.BUILDING_ID
LEFT JOIN building_assignable_area ba
  ON rc.BUILDING_ID = ba.BUILDING_ID
LEFT JOIN fac_building b
  ON rc.BUILDING_ID = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE rc.ROOM_AREA IS NOT NULL
  AND fa.SQFT_ASSIGNABLE_FLOOR IS NOT NULL
  AND fa.SQFT_ASSIGNABLE_FLOOR <> 0
  AND ba.ASSIGNABLE_SQFT IS NOT NULL
  AND ba.ASSIGNABLE_SQFT <> 0

rows.question: Show the details of rooms including the full name of the rooms, the building names, floor numbers, the organizations occupying them, name of the departments occupying them, and the percentage of the room area over the floor area and building.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH rank_latest_fclt_building_by_key AS (
  SELECT
    f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    f.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    f.BUILDING_NAME,
    f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    f.EXT_GROSS_AREA,
    f.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
      ORDER BY (f.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NULL), f.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC
    ) AS row_rank
  FROM fclt_building f
),
-- canonical room-level attributes from fac_rooms (grain = FAC_ROOM_KEY)
room_basic_attrs AS (
  SELECT
    FAC_ROOM_KEY AS ROOM_ID,
    ROOM_FULL_NAME AS ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    AREA AS ROOM_AREA,
    FLOOR AS FLOOR,
    BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING,
    ORGANIZATION_NAME AS OCCUPYING_ORGANIZATION,
    DEPT_CODE AS OCCUPYING_DEPARTMENT
  FROM fac_rooms
  WHERE
    FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND ROOM_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND AREA IS NOT NULL
    AND FLOOR IS NOT NULL
    AND BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
),
-- lookup building name and gross area from buildings (required by spec)
building_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS GROSS_SQUARE_FEET
  FROM buildings b
),
-- per-floor totals (within same building and floor)
floor_totals AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING,
    FLOOR,
    SUM(ROOM_AREA) AS floor_total_area
  FROM room_basic_attrs
  GROUP BY BUILDING, FLOOR
)
SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_full_name,
  bl.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  r.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  r.OCCUPYING_ORGANIZATION AS occupying_organization,
  r.OCCUPYING_DEPARTMENT AS occupying_department,
  (r.ROOM_AREA / f.floor_total_area) * 100 AS pct_of_floor_area,
  (r.ROOM_AREA / bl.GROSS_SQUARE_FEET) * 100 AS pct_of_building_area
FROM room_basic_attrs r
JOIN building_lookup bl
  ON r.BUILDING = bl.BUILDING
JOIN floor_totals f
  ON r.BUILDING = f.BUILDING
  AND r.FLOOR = f.FLOOR
WHERE
  r.ROOM_AREA IS NOT NULL
  AND f.floor_total_area IS NOT NULL
  AND f.floor_total_area <> 0
  AND bl.GROSS_SQUARE_FEET IS NOT NULL
  AND bl.GROSS_SQUARE_FEET <> 0
ORDER BY bl.BUILDING_NAME, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM_FULL_NAME

rows.question: What are the academic year, and instructors names for courses offered in the academic year 2022, along with the total number of types of courses per instructor?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  cc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
  TRIM(ins.instructor_name) AS instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ins.course_type) AS total_course_types_per_instructor
FROM (
  -- union course sources, keep instructor lists from both fall and spring
  SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
  FROM drupal_course_catalog
) cc
-- Expand instructors by splitting comma-separated lists from FALL_INSTRUCTORS and SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
JOIN (
  SELECT
    src.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    src.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    src.TERM_CODE,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(src.instrs, ',', n.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor_name,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(src.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,''), '|', COALESCE(src.TERM_CODE,'')) AS course_type
  FROM (
    -- rows with one instructor-list column at a time (fall then spring)
    SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE, FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS instrs FROM (
      SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
      UNION ALL
      SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS FROM drupal_course_catalog
    ) x
    UNION ALL
    SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS AS instrs FROM (
      SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
      UNION ALL
      SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS FROM drupal_course_catalog
    ) y
  ) src
  JOIN (
    -- numbers 1..20 for splitting up to 20 instructors
    SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
  ) n
  ON src.instrs IS NOT NULL
    AND src.instrs <> ''
    -- ensure we only take as many positions as there are commas+1
    AND n.n <= 1 + CHAR_LENGTH(src.instrs) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(src.instrs, ',', ''))
) ins
  ON ins.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = cc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
     AND (ins.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cc.ACADEMIC_YEAR OR (ins.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL AND cc.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL))
     AND ins.TERM_CODE = cc.TERM_CODE
WHERE cc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
  AND ins.instructor_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(ins.instructor_name) <> ''
GROUP BY cc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TRIM(ins.instructor_name)
ORDER BY TRIM(ins.instructor_name)

rows.question: What are the building names, department names, organizations, their highest and lowest floor number, along with the total number of rooms per each building key?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_master AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  FROM buildings b
),
-- derive departments/organizations associated via fac_building (if present) and fac_organization
building_depts_orgs AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.COST_CENTER_CODE AS DEPT_CODE,
    fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME
  FROM fac_building fb
  LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo
    ON fb.COST_CENTER_CODE = fo.D_CODE
  WHERE fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
-- room-level aggregates per building from fclt_rooms (use fac_rooms/fclt_rooms whichever has data; union to be safe)
rooms_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(CAST(NULLIF(FLOOR,'') AS SIGNED)) AS max_floor,
    MIN(CAST(NULLIF(FLOOR,'') AS SIGNED)) AS min_floor,
    COUNT(*) AS room_count
  FROM fclt_rooms
  WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(CAST(NULLIF(FLOOR,'') AS SIGNED)) AS max_floor,
    MIN(CAST(NULLIF(FLOOR,'') AS SIGNED)) AS min_floor,
    COUNT(*) AS room_count
  FROM fac_rooms
  WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
),
-- combine room aggregates if both sources had rows for same building
rooms_merged AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(max_floor) AS max_floor,
    MIN(min_floor) AS min_floor,
    SUM(room_count) AS room_count
  FROM rooms_per_building
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  bm.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  bm.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  -- concatenated distinct department names (empty string if none)
  NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT bd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY bd.DEPARTMENT_NAME SEPARATOR '; '), '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAMES,
  -- concatenated distinct organization names (NULL if none)
  NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT bd.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY bd.ORGANIZATION_NAME SEPARATOR '; '), '') AS ORGANIZATIONS,
  -- highest/lowest floor as integers; if no rooms, return NULL per spec
  rm.max_floor AS HIGHEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
  rm.min_floor AS LOWEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
  -- total rooms as integer; if no rooms, return 0 as allowed
  COALESCE(rm.room_count, 0) AS TOTAL_ROOMS
FROM building_master bm
LEFT JOIN building_depts_orgs bd
  ON bm.BUILDING_KEY = bd.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN rooms_merged rm
  ON bm.BUILDING_KEY = rm.BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  bm.BUILDING_KEY,
  bm.BUILDING_NAME,
  rm.max_floor,
  rm.min_floor,
  rm.room_count
ORDER BY bm.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: Provide the complete information for students with the first name Kevin, including their full names, email addresses, department names, department phone numbers, school names, and the total student count per department and school. If a student is associated with more than one department, list a separate row for each department.

SELECT

  s.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE,
  COALESCE(sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd_sis.SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  dc.DEPARTMENT_STUDENT_COUNT,
  sc.SCHOOL_STUDENT_COUNT
FROM mit_student_directory s
JOIN student_department sd
  ON s.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department sad
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN sis_department sd_sis
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd_sis.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct students (by FULL_NAME) per department for all students (but restricted to Kevins below)
  SELECT
    m.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_STUDENT_COUNT
  FROM mit_student_directory m
  WHERE m.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'
  GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT
) dc
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE

  ON COALESCE(sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd_sis.SCHOOL_CODE) = sc.SCHOOL_CODE
WHERE s.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'

rows.question: What are the unique titles of subjects offered in the fall term along with their instructor names, instructor emails, and the total number of types of subjects per instructor?

WITH fall_pairs AS (
  -- gather fall subject_title + instructor info, resolving email when possible
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY AS subj_inst_id,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
    so.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS responsible_faculty_name,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS responsible_faculty_mit_id,
    d.MIT_ID AS mit_id,
    d.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS email_address,
    d.FULL_NAME AS full_name
  FROM subject_offered so
  LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory d
    -- prefer MIT_ID match when present
    ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
       AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> ''
       AND d.MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID

  UNION

  -- when no MIT_ID, try exact full name match
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    d.MIT_ID,
    d.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    d.FULL_NAME
  FROM subject_offered so
  JOIN drupal_employee_directory d
    ON ( (so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NULL OR so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = '')
         AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
         AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME <> ''
         AND d.FULL_NAME = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME )

  UNION

  -- when still unresolved, try first + ' ' + last name match
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    d.MIT_ID,
    d.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    d.FULL_NAME
  FROM subject_offered so
  JOIN drupal_employee_directory d
    ON ( (so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NULL OR so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = '')
         AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
         AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME <> ''
         AND CONCAT(d.FIRST_NAME, ' ', d.LAST_NAME) = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME )
),

instructor_fall_counts AS (
  -- count distinct subject titles per instructor (by MIT_ID or email) considering only fall terms
  SELECT
    COALESCE(d.MIT_ID, '') AS mit_id,
    COALESCE(d.EMAIL_ADDRESS, '') AS email_address,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subjects_taught_in_fall
  FROM drupal_employee_directory d
  JOIN subject_offered so
    ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = d.MIT_ID
  WHERE so.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND RIGHT(so.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA'
  GROUP BY d.MIT_ID, d.EMAIL_ADDRESS

  UNION

  -- also count instructors that were matched by name only (no MIT_ID on subject_offered),
  -- i.e., join by full name from drupal_employee_directory to responsible name on subject_offered
  SELECT
    '' AS mit_id,
    COALESCE(d.EMAIL_ADDRESS, '') AS email_address,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subjects_taught_in_fall
  FROM drupal_employee_directory d
  JOIN subject_offered so
    ON ( (so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NULL OR so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = '')
         AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = d.FULL_NAME )
  WHERE so.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND RIGHT(so.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA'
  GROUP BY d.EMAIL_ADDRESS
)

SELECT
  DISTINCT fp.subject_title AS subject_title,
  -- prefer the responsible name from subject_offered; fall back to drupal full_name
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fp.responsible_faculty_name, ''), NULLIF(fp.full_name, '')) AS instructor_name,
  fp.email_address AS instructor_email,
  COALESCE(ifc.subjects_taught_in_fall, 0) AS subjects_taught_by_instructor_in_fall
FROM fall_pairs fp
JOIN drupal_employee_directory ded
  ON ( (fp.mit_id IS NOT NULL AND fp.mit_id <> '' AND ded.MIT_ID = fp.mit_id)
       OR ( (fp.mit_id IS NULL OR fp.mit_id = '') AND ded.EMAIL_ADDRESS = fp.email_address ) )
LEFT JOIN instructor_fall_counts ifc
  ON ( (fp.mit_id IS NOT NULL AND fp.mit_id <> '' AND ifc.mit_id = fp.mit_id)
       OR ( (fp.mit_id IS NULL OR fp.mit_id = '') AND ifc.email_address = fp.email_address ) )
WHERE fp.term_code IS NOT NULL
  AND RIGHT(fp.term_code,2) = 'FA'
  -- require that an email was resolved (per requirements)
  AND fp.email_address IS NOT NULL
  AND fp.email_address <> ''
ORDER BY instructor_name ASC, subject_title ASC

rows.question: List the building names, names of HR departments occupying them, the total gross square footage, the total and average assignable square footage, and the built year per building key.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  -- concatenate distinct HR org unit titles associated with this building (or NULL if none)
  NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ORDER BY d.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE SEPARATOR ', '), '') AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE,
  -- sums: only aggregate non-NULL numeric values (SUM ignores NULLs by default)
  SUM(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS TOTAL_BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  SUM(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS TOTAL_BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  -- average: compute only when there is at least one non-null assignable value; AVG ignores NULLs but we return NULL when no non-null rows
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE AVG(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE)
  END AS AVG_BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  -- extract 4-digit year from DATE_BUILT expected in "%m/%d/%Y"; if not a valid date or NULL return NULL
  CASE
    WHEN f.DATE_BUILT IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN STR_TO_DATE(f.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(f.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y')
  END AS BUILT_YEAR
FROM buildings b
-- link buildings to drupal_employee_directory by OFFICE_LOCATION -> BUILDING_NUMBER (best available association in schema)
LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory d
  ON d.OFFICE_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
-- bring in DATE_BUILT from fac_building where BUILDING_NUMBER matches; LEFT JOIN so missing rows yield NULL built year
LEFT JOIN fac_building f
  ON f.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
WHERE
  b.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME ASC

dept_course_types AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS department_code,
    -- count distinct type flags present per department (lecture, lab, recitation, design)
    MAX(IF(UPPER(IFNULL(IS_LECTURE_SECTION,'')) = 'Y', 1, 0)) +
    MAX(IF(UPPER(IFNULL(IS_LAB_SECTION,'')) = 'Y', 1, 0)) +
    MAX(IF(UPPER(IFNULL(IS_RECITATION_SECTION,'')) = 'Y', 1, 0)) +
    MAX(IF(UPPER(IFNULL(IS_DESIGN_SECTION,'')) = 'Y', 1, 0)) AS total_course_types_per_department
  FROM (
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, IS_LECTURE_SECTION, IS_LAB_SECTION, IS_RECITATION_SECTION, IS_DESIGN_SECTION
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, IS_LECTURE_SECTION, IS_LAB_SECTION, IS_RECITATION_SECTION, IS_DESIGN_SECTION
    FROM cis_course_catalog
    UNION ALL
    -- include drupal rows (may not have flags) so department still appears
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS IS_LECTURE_SECTION, NULL AS IS_LAB_SECTION, NULL AS IS_RECITATION_SECTION, NULL AS IS_DESIGN_SECTION
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
  ) t
  GROUP BY COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '')
)
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS title,
  s.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION AS description,
  r.FULL_NAME AS responsible_faculty_name,
  r.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_faculty_email,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  -- prefer fclt_rooms.room_full_name then fac_rooms.room_full_name then meet_place literal
  COALESCE(fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME, facr.ROOM_FULL_NAME, s.MEET_PLACE) AS room_name,
  -- floor from matched rooms or MEET_TIME as fallback (user requested floor level; MEET_TIME is imperfect)
  COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, facr.FLOOR, s.MEET_TIME) AS floor_level,
  -- prefer street name + number if available (street address requirement)
  CONCAT_WS(' ',
    NULLIF(ba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
    NULLIF(ba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
    NULLIF(ba.STREET_NAME, ''),
    NULLIF(ba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
    NULLIF(ba.POST_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
    NULLIF(ba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX, '')
  ) AS building_street_address,
  dct.total_course_types_per_department AS total_course_types_per_department
FROM subjects_union s
LEFT JOIN responsible_faculty_contact r
  ON r.MIT_ID = s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
-- try to resolve meeting place to facility rooms by ROOM_FULL_NAME, SPACE_ID, ROOM or FAC identifiers
LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr
  ON (fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME = s.MEET_PLACE)
     OR (fr.SPACE_ID IS NOT NULL AND fr.SPACE_ID = s.MEET_PLACE)
     OR (fr.ROOM IS NOT NULL AND fr.ROOM = s.MEET_PLACE)
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms facr
  ON (facr.ROOM_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND facr.ROOM_FULL_NAME = s.MEET_PLACE)
     OR (facr.SPACE_ID IS NOT NULL AND facr.SPACE_ID = s.MEET_PLACE)
     OR (facr.ROOM IS NOT NULL AND facr.ROOM = s.MEET_PLACE)
-- link building from either rooms table (use building keys/ids available)
LEFT JOIN fac_building b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
     OR b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = facr.BUILDING_KEY
     OR b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
     OR b.BUILDING_KEY = facr.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address ba
  ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  AND ba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN dept_course_types dct
  ON dct.department_code = COALESCE(s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '')
WHERE
  -- filter to summer term: TERM_CODE formatted YYYYTT where TT = 'SU'
  (s.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(s.TERM_CODE,2) = 'SU')
  OR (
    s.TERM_CODE IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
      WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE
        AND c.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
        AND RIGHT(c.TERM_CODE,2) = 'SU'
    )
  )

WITH cis_hass_attr_dim AS (

academic_term_rows AS (

ccso_filtered AS (

rows.question: List building names, their height, street address, city, state, postal code, their gross and assignable square footage, the smallest and largest floor level and the total area of all rooms for each building key.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_street_address AS (
  SELECT
    `fac_building_address`.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
    TRIM(
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(`fac_building_address`.`STREET_NUMBER`, ''), ''),
        CASE 
          WHEN `fac_building_address`.`STREET_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL 
            AND `fac_building_address`.`STREET_NUMBER` <> '' 
            AND `fac_building_address`.`STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX` IS NOT NULL 
            AND `fac_building_address`.`STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX` <> '' 
          THEN CONCAT('', `fac_building_address`.`STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX`) 
          ELSE '' 
        END,
        IF(
          (`fac_building_address`.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL` IS NOT NULL AND `fac_building_address`.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL` <> ''),
          CONCAT(' ', `fac_building_address`.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL`),
          ''
        ),
        IF(
          (`fac_building_address`.`STREET_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND `fac_building_address`.`STREET_NAME` <> ''),
          CONCAT(
            CASE 
              WHEN (`fac_building_address`.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL` IS NOT NULL AND `fac_building_address`.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL` <> '') 
                OR (`fac_building_address`.`STREET_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND `fac_building_address`.`STREET_NUMBER` <> '') 
              THEN ' ' 
              ELSE '' 
            END,
            `fac_building_address`.`STREET_NAME`
          ),
          ''
        ),
        IF(
          (`fac_building_address`.`STREET_SUFFIX` IS NOT NULL AND `fac_building_address`.`STREET_SUFFIX` <> ''),
          CONCAT(' ', `fac_building_address`.`STREET_SUFFIX`),
          ''
        ),
        IF(
          (`fac_building_address`.`POST_DIRECTIONAL` IS NOT NULL AND `fac_building_address`.`POST_DIRECTIONAL` <> ''),
          CONCAT(' ', `fac_building_address`.`POST_DIRECTIONAL`),
          ''
        )
      )
    ) AS `STREET_ADDRESS`,
    `fac_building_address`.`CITY` AS `CITY`,
    `fac_building_address`.`STATE` AS `STATE`,
    `fac_building_address`.`POSTAL_CODE` AS `POSTAL_CODE`
  FROM `fac_building_address`
  WHERE `fac_building_address`.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` = 'STREET'
),
building_floor_levels AS (
  SELECT
    f.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(CASE WHEN f.FLOOR REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(f.FLOOR AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END) AS MIN_FLOOR_NUM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.FLOOR REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(f.FLOOR AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END) AS MAX_FLOOR_NUM,
    MIN(f.FLOOR) AS MIN_FLOOR_STR,
    MAX(f.FLOOR) AS MAX_FLOOR_STR
  FROM fac_floor f
  GROUP BY f.BUILDING_KEY
),
building_floor_extents AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    -- prefer numeric min/max when available, otherwise use string min/max
    CASE WHEN MIN_FLOOR_NUM IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(MIN_FLOOR_NUM AS CHAR) ELSE MIN_FLOOR_STR END AS smallest_floor,
    CASE WHEN MAX_FLOOR_NUM IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(MAX_FLOOR_NUM AS CHAR) ELSE MAX_FLOOR_STR END AS largest_floor
  FROM building_floor_levels
),
rooms_area AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(COALESCE(AREA,0)) AS total_area_rooms_sqft
  FROM fac_rooms
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  -- BUILDING_HEIGHT may exist in fac_building or fclt_building; prefer fac_building then fclt_building then NULL
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT, fcb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  s.STREET_ADDRESS AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  s.CITY AS CITY,
  s.STATE AS STATE,
  s.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE,
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  bf.smallest_floor AS MIN_FLOOR_LEVEL,
  bf.largest_floor AS MAX_FLOOR_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(r.total_area_rooms_sqft, 0) AS TOTAL_ROOM_AREA
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN building_street_address s
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = s.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_floor_extents bf
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = bf.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN rooms_area r
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fcb
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fcb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: What is the category title, version, department name, school name, total number of courses for each course level, and the total number of degree-granting courses for each CIP category code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- courses annotated with their CIP PROGRAM_CODE (from SIS course description), department, and school
courses AS (
  SELECT
    sc.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY AS COURSE_KEY,
    sc.COURSE AS COURSE_CODE,
    sc.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS PROGRAM_CODE,                -- links to cip.program_code
    sc.COURSE_LEVEL,                                    -- 'U' or 'G' (may be NULL)
    sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,                              -- 'Y' if degree-granting (may be NULL)
    sc.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,                   -- department code linked to sis_department.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- normalize school name, map 'Center for International Studies' -> 'CIS'
    CASE
      WHEN sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Center for International Studies' THEN 'CIS'
      ELSE sd.SCHOOL_NAME
    END AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM sis_course_description sc
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
    ON sc.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE sc.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL
),

-- derive CIP category info: prefer cip_with_version.VERSION when available, otherwise cip.VERSION
cip_category AS (
  SELECT
    c.PROGRAM_CODE,
    c.CATEGORY_CODE,
    c.CATEGORY_TITLE,
    COALESCE(wv.VERSION, c.VERSION) AS VERSION
  FROM cip c
  LEFT JOIN cip_with_version wv
    ON c.CATEGORY_CODE = wv.CATEGORY_CODE
)

SELECT
  cc.CATEGORY_CODE AS CATEGORY_CODE,
  cc.CATEGORY_TITLE AS CATEGORY_TITLE,
  cc.VERSION AS VERSION,
  -- include department(s) associated with courses in that CIP category
  COALESCE(c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  c.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- totals: count only when COURSE_LEVEL exactly 'U' or 'G'
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_UNDERGRADUATE_COURSES,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_GRADUATE_COURSES,
  -- count degree-granting courses where IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_DEGREE_GRANTING_COURSES
FROM cip_category cc
JOIN courses c
  ON cc.PROGRAM_CODE = c.PROGRAM_CODE
-- Only include CIP categories that appear in course data (the JOIN enforces that)
GROUP BY
  cc.CATEGORY_CODE,
  cc.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  cc.VERSION,
  COALESCE(c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE),
  c.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  cc.CATEGORY_CODE ASC

rows.question: What is the total number of library materials, the minimum and maximum publication years, and the total number of materials status for each course name?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH material_course_link AS (
  SELECT
    lrm.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` AS MATERIAL_ID,
    -- try course title from cis_course_catalog, then course_catalog_subject_offered, then drupal_course_catalog
    COALESCE(ccc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, cso.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, dcc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`) AS course_name,
    lrc.`CATALOG_YEAR` AS publication_year,
    lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE` AS status_code
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` AS lrm
  LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` AS lrc
    ON lrm.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = lrc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `library_material_status` AS lms
    ON lrm.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
  -- link to library_subject_offered when present to get subject identifiers
  LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` AS lso
    ON lrm.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lso.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  -- attempt to join to course catalog tables using available identifiers
  LEFT JOIN `cis_course_catalog` AS ccc
    ON (lso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND ccc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = lso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`)
       AND (lso.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND ccc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = lso.`TERM_CODE`)
  LEFT JOIN `course_catalog_subject_offered` AS cso
    ON (lso.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND cso.`SUBJECT_ID` = lso.`SUBJECT_ID`)
       AND (lso.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND cso.`TERM_CODE` = lso.`TERM_CODE`)
  LEFT JOIN `drupal_course_catalog` AS dcc
    ON (lso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND dcc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = lso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`)
       AND (lso.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND dcc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = lso.`TERM_CODE`)
),
publication_years AS (
  SELECT
    MATERIAL_ID,
    course_name,
    status_code,
    -- try to parse an integer year; ignore non-parsable by producing NULL
    NULLIF(
      CAST(
        NULLIF(TRIM(publication_year),'') AS SIGNED
      ), 0
    ) AS publication_year_int
  FROM material_course_link
)
SELECT
  course_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_materials,
  MIN(publication_year_int) AS min_publication_year,
  MAX(publication_year_int) AS max_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT status_code) AS total_status_count
FROM publication_years
WHERE course_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY course_name
ORDER BY total_materials DESC

rows.question: What is the total number of library reserve materials, the minimum and maximum publication years, and the total number of enrolled students for each course instructor?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH instructor_identity AS (
  -- All distinct instructor names from course/section tables and library instructor table
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS instructor_name
  FROM subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) <> ''
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS instructor_name
  FROM library_course_instructor
  WHERE INSTRUCTOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(INSTRUCTOR_NAME) <> ''
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) AS instructor_name
  FROM cis_course_catalog
  WHERE FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) <> ''
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) AS instructor_name
  FROM cis_course_catalog
  WHERE SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) <> ''
),
instructor_reserve_materials AS (
  -- link reserve detail -> course_instructor -> reserve catalog to get publication year per instructor
  SELECT
    TRIM(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS instructor_name,
    lcmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS material_id,
    lcat.CATALOG_YEAR AS publication_year
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lcmd
  JOIN library_course_instructor lci
    ON lcmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lcat
    ON lcmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lcat.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) <> ''
),
reserve_agg AS (
  SELECT
    instructor_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_reserve_materials,
    MIN(CAST(publication_year AS SIGNED)) AS min_publication_year,
    MAX(CAST(publication_year AS SIGNED)) AS max_publication_year
  FROM instructor_reserve_materials
  -- ignore non-numeric/null publication_year for min/max by filtering here;
  -- keep rows for counting materials even if publication_year is non-numeric? The spec says ignore non-numeric when computing min/max.
  GROUP BY instructor_name
),
-- Enrollment rollup by instructor from subject_offered.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
instructor_enrollment_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS instructor_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS END), 0) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) <> ''
  GROUP BY TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
)
SELECT
  ii.instructor_name AS instructor_name,
  COALESCE(r.total_reserve_materials, 0) AS total_reserve_materials,
  -- min/max should ignore non-numeric; compute explicitly by casting only numeric strings
  CASE
    WHEN r.min_publication_year IS NOT NULL THEN r.min_publication_year
    ELSE NULL
  END AS min_publication_year,
  CASE
    WHEN r.max_publication_year IS NOT NULL THEN r.max_publication_year
    ELSE NULL
  END AS max_publication_year,
  COALESCE(e.total_enrolled_students, 0) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM instructor_identity ii
LEFT JOIN (
  -- recompute min/max while ignoring non-numeric publication years
  SELECT
    instructor_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_reserve_materials,
    MIN(pub_year_num) AS min_publication_year,
    MAX(pub_year_num) AS max_publication_year
  FROM (
    SELECT
      instructor_name,
      material_id,
      -- attempt to cast publication year to integer when purely numeric (optional leading/trailing spaces handled by TRIM)
      CASE
        WHEN TRIM(publication_year) REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(publication_year) AS SIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END AS pub_year_num
    FROM instructor_reserve_materials
  ) t
  GROUP BY instructor_name
) r ON r.instructor_name = ii.instructor_name
LEFT JOIN instructor_enrollment_rollup e
  ON e.instructor_name = ii.instructor_name
ORDER BY ii.instructor_name ASC

rows.question: What is the material status, term description, total number of courses and materials, occurences in departments and school, and the total number of instructors for each library material status code and term code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH material_status_lookup_101 AS (
SELECT
  `library_material_status`.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE` AS MATRL_STATUS_CD,
  `library_material_status`.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS MATRL_STATUS_DESC
FROM
  `library_material_status`
),
term_descriptions AS (
SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ata.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE_all,
  ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_all
FROM academic_terms AS at
RIGHT JOIN academic_terms_all AS ata
  ON at.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
UNION
SELECT
  at2.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  at2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ata2.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE_all,
  ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_all
FROM academic_terms AS at2
LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all AS ata2
  ON at2.TERM_CODE = ata2.TERM_CODE
WHERE ata2.TERM_CODE IS NULL
)
SELECT
  lms.MATRL_STATUS_CD AS material_status_code,
  drm.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  lms.MATRL_STATUS_DESC AS material_status_description,
  term_descriptions.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS('|',
    NULLIF(ls.SUBJECT_ID,''),
    NULLIF(ls.COURSE_NUMBER,'')
  )) AS total_courses,
  COUNT(*) AS total_materials,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_PUBLISHER,'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(ls.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS department_occurrences,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(ls.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS school_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, '')) AS total_instructors
FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail drm
JOIN library_material_status lms_full
  ON drm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms_full.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN material_status_lookup_101 lms
  ON lms.MATRL_STATUS_CD = lms_full.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
  ON drm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered ls
  ON drm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = ls.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON drm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN term_descriptions
  ON drm.TERM_CODE = term_descriptions.TERM_CODE
WHERE NULLIF(drm.TERM_CODE,'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(lms.MATRL_STATUS_CD,'') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY lms.MATRL_STATUS_CD, drm.TERM_CODE, lms.MATRL_STATUS_DESC, term_descriptions.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY lms.MATRL_STATUS_CD ASC, drm.TERM_CODE ASC

rows.question: For building 36, list all space units, their floor and building name, building street address, their space usage, and the number of organizations and space units on the same building and floor.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH counts_per_building_floor AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    ff.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_ID,
    ff.FLOOR AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_organizations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.SPACE_ID) AS num_space_units
  FROM fac_floor AS ff
  JOIN fac_rooms AS fr
    ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
    AND fr.BUILDING_KEY = ff.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    ff.FLOOR_KEY,
    ff.FLOOR
),
space_units_with_floor_building AS (
  SELECT
    fr.SPACE_ID                       AS SPACE_UNIT_IDENTIFIER,
    fr.ROOM                           AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY                   AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    ff.FLOOR_KEY                      AS FLOOR_ID,
    COALESCE(ff.FLOOR, fr.FLOOR)      AS FLOOR,
    COALESCE(fr.MINOR_USE_DESC, fr.USE_DESC, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS SPACE_USAGE,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY               AS ORGANIZATION_KEY
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
    ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
    AND fr.BUILDING_KEY = ff.BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  sufb.SPACE_UNIT_IDENTIFIER AS SPACE_UNIT_IDENTIFIER,
  sufb.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  CONCAT(
    COALESCE(ab.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
    CASE WHEN ab.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND ab.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ab.STREET_NAME, ''),
    CASE WHEN (ab.CITY IS NOT NULL AND (ab.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL OR ab.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL)) THEN ', ' WHEN (ab.CITY IS NOT NULL AND (ab.STREET_NUMBER IS NULL AND ab.STREET_NAME IS NULL)) THEN '' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ab.CITY, ''),
    CASE WHEN ab.STATE IS NOT NULL AND ab.CITY IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' WHEN ab.STATE IS NOT NULL AND ab.CITY IS NULL AND (ab.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL OR ab.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL) THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ab.STATE, ''),
    CASE WHEN ab.POSTAL_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ab.POSTAL_CODE, '')
  ) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  sufb.SPACE_USAGE AS SPACE_USAGE,
  COALESCE(c.num_organizations, 0) AS NUM_ORGANIZATIONS_ON_SAME_BUILDING_FLOOR,
  COALESCE(c.num_space_units, 0) AS NUM_SPACE_UNITS_ON_SAME_BUILDING_FLOOR
FROM space_units_with_floor_building AS sufb
JOIN buildings AS b
  ON sufb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, STREET_NUMBER, STREET_NAME, CITY, STATE, POSTAL_CODE
  FROM fac_building_address
  WHERE ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
) AS ab
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = ab.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN counts_per_building_floor AS c
  ON sufb.BUILDING_NUMBER = c.BUILDING_NUMBER
  AND sufb.FLOOR_ID = c.FLOOR_ID
WHERE sufb.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'

rows.question: For each distinct mailing list containing more than 1000 people and with a name starting with A (case insensitive), provide its name, whether it is a mailing list, whether it is a moira group, whether it is a NFS group, the owner of the mailing list, and the number of people in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_members_count AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  LEFT JOIN moira_list ml
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
moira_list_owner_choice AS (
  SELECT t.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, t.OWNER
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
      o.OWNER,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
        ORDER BY 
          COALESCE(NULLIF(d.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, ''), '0000-00-00') DESC,
          COALESCE(NULLIF(o.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, ''), '0000-00-00') DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM moira_list_detail d
    LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner o
      ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  ) AS t
  WHERE t.rn = 1
)
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST AS is_mailing_list,
  m.IS_MOIRA_GROUP AS is_moira_group,
  m.IS_NFS_GROUP AS is_nfs_group,
  dlo.OWNER AS owner,
  mlmc.member_count AS member_count
FROM moira_list m
JOIN moira_list_members_count mlmc
  ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlmc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner_choice dlo
  ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = dlo.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE mlmc.member_count > 1000
  AND m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'A%' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci

rows.question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- basic list properties
moira_lists AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS list_key,
    `MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS list_name,
    `IS_PUBLIC` AS is_public,
    `IS_HIDDEN` AS is_hidden,
    `IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST` AS is_moira_mail
  FROM moira_list
),
-- count distinct members per list (ignore NULL members)
member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS list_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  WHERE d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
-- determine global min and max member counts among lists that have a count
min_max AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(member_count) AS min_members,
    MAX(member_count) AS max_members
  FROM member_counts
),
-- map lists to owners (use owner key present in moira_list_detail and join to owner table)
list_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS list_key,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY AS owner_key
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  WHERE d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ml.list_key,
  ml.list_name AS list_name,
  mo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY AS owner_id,
  mo.OWNER AS owner,
  ml.is_public,
  ml.is_hidden,
  mc.member_count,
  -- interpret system: if flagged as moira mailing list mark 'MOIRA', else NULL (could be extended if data had another system)
  CASE WHEN ml.is_moira_mail = 'Y' OR ml.is_moira_mail = 'y' OR ml.is_moira_mail = '1' THEN 'MOIRA' ELSE NULL END AS mailing_list_system
FROM moira_lists ml
JOIN member_counts mc ON mc.list_key = ml.list_key
JOIN min_max mm ON mc.member_count = mm.min_members OR mc.member_count = mm.max_members
-- bring each owner as a separate row; if a list has no owner entry in moira_list_detail it will be excluded per requirement to return one row per (mailing list, owner)
JOIN list_owners lo ON lo.list_key = ml.list_key
JOIN moira_list_owner mo ON mo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = lo.owner_key
-- Only include lists with a recorded member_count (member_counts join already enforces this)

rows.question: For email lists with names starting with C (case insensitive) and containing faculty who teach courses in the summer in financial aid years after 2001, provide the name of the list, the number of people in the list, and the number of faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH summer_terms_after_2001 AS (
SELECT
  so.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE
FROM
  subject_offered AS so
WHERE
  so.TERM_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%','SU')
  AND CAST(LEFT(so.TERM_CODE,4) AS UNSIGNED) > 2001
GROUP BY
  so.TERM_CODE
),
person_employee_directory_map AS (
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER       AS `MEMBER`,
  d.MIT_ID                  AS `csid`,
  d.MIT_ID                  AS `mit_id`
FROM
  moira_list_detail AS m
LEFT JOIN
  drupal_employee_directory AS d
    ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = d.MIT_ID
)
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS num_people,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fs.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER END) AS num_faculty
FROM moira_list m
JOIN moira_list_detail d ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN person_employee_directory_map pem ON pem.MEMBER = d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory de ON de.MIT_ID = pem.mit_id
-- pre-aggregate faculty who taught any summer term after 2001
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID
  FROM subject_offered s
  JOIN summer_terms_after_2001 st ON st.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> ''
) fs ON fs.MIT_ID = pem.mit_id
WHERE m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'C%' OR m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'c%'
GROUP BY m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: Regarding the mailing list about duo users, provide the number of students in this list, and the number of departments and schools associated with these students.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_members AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS mit_id
  FROM moira_list_detail AS mld
  JOIN moira_list AS ml
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'candle-duo-users'
    AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) <> ''
),
-- map moira members to person records from opa_person_current
persons AS (
  SELECT
    opc.MIT_ID,
    opc.FULL_NAME,
    opc.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD AS department_code_old
  FROM opa_person_current AS opc
  JOIN moira_members AS mm
    ON opc.MIT_ID = mm.mit_id
),
-- get department / school from sis_department using department code
person_dept_school AS (
  SELECT
    p.MIT_ID AS mit_id,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code,
    sd.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code
  FROM persons AS p
  LEFT JOIN sis_department AS sd
    ON p.department_code_old = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT md.mit_id) AS student_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pd.department_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pd.department_code) <> '' THEN pd.department_code END) AS distinct_department_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pd.school_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pd.school_code) <> '' THEN pd.school_code END) AS distinct_school_count
FROM moira_members AS md
-- left join to include members even if no sis_department match; counts use non-null filters
LEFT JOIN person_dept_school AS pd
  ON md.mit_id = pd.mit_id

rows.question: For faculty who are responsible for courses in 2023 fall term, list the name of mailing lists with ten members that they subscribe to, the number of faculty in these lists, and the number of courses associated with those faculty.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_lists_with_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
  FROM moira_list ml
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
-- faculty who are responsible for courses in 2023FA, with their course counts
faculty_courses_2023fa AS (
  SELECT
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS faculty_name,
    COUNT(*) AS course_count
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
    AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME <> ''
  GROUP BY so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
),
-- join moira members to faculty who taught in 2023FA
moira_faculty_members AS (
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    m.member_count,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS faculty_name
  FROM moira_lists_with_member_counts m
  JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  -- only consider lists that are recorded in moira_list as moira lists
  JOIN moira_list ml ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y' OR ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = '1' OR ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST IS NULL
)
SELECT
  mf.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MAILING_LIST_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fc.faculty_name) AS FACULTY_COUNT,
  COALESCE(SUM(fc.course_count), 0) AS COURSE_COUNT
FROM moira_faculty_members mf
JOIN faculty_courses_2023fa fc
  ON fc.faculty_name = mf.faculty_name
WHERE mf.member_count = 10
GROUP BY mf.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, mf.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY mf.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For each course instructor in the 'keeper-zephyr' mailing list, provide the name of mailing lists they subscribe to, instructor name, earliest and latest publication years, and total number of enrolled students.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_membership AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  JOIN moira_list ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
),
-- publications per instructor identifier (use INSTRUCTOR_NAME and treat 4-digit years)
publications AS (
  SELECT
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS member_identifier,
    MIN(CASE WHEN lr.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lr.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN lr.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lr.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS latest_publication_year
  FROM library_course_instructor lci
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail rmd
    ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  JOIN library_reserve_catalog lr
    ON rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  GROUP BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
),
-- enrollment totals per responsible faculty (aggregate NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, treat null as 0)
enrollments AS (
  SELECT
    sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS by_mit_id,
    sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS by_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM subject_offered_summary sos
  GROUP BY sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
),
-- all mailing lists each member subscribes to (to return mailing_list_name(s) they are subscribed to)
member_lists AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS mailing_lists
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  JOIN moira_list ml ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(meml.mailing_lists, 'keeper-zephyr') AS mailing_list_name,
  -- preferred FULL_NAME from employee_directory then drupal_employee_directory then build from first/last in those tables then fall back to the raw moira member string
  COALESCE(
    ed.FULL_NAME,
    ded.FULL_NAME,
    CONCAT_WS(' ', ed.FIRST_NAME, ed.LAST_NAME),
    CONCAT_WS(' ', ded.FIRST_NAME, ded.LAST_NAME),
    m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  ) AS instructor_name,
  pub.earliest_publication_year,
  pub.latest_publication_year,
  COALESCE(en.total_enrolled_students, 0) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM moira_list_membership m
LEFT JOIN member_lists meml
  ON meml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
  ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS
LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory ded
  ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = ded.EMAIL_ADDRESS
LEFT JOIN publications pub
  -- publications are keyed by instructor name; attempt to match by various name forms
  ON pub.member_identifier = COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME, ded.FULL_NAME, m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
     OR pub.member_identifier = COALESCE(CONCAT_WS(' ', ed.FIRST_NAME, ed.LAST_NAME), CONCAT_WS(' ', ded.FIRST_NAME, ded.LAST_NAME), m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
LEFT JOIN enrollments en
  -- match enrollments by MIT_ID (if moira list detail provides MIT id) or by name
  ON (m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID <> '' AND m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = en.by_mit_id)
     OR (en.by_name IS NOT NULL AND en.by_name <> '' AND (
          en.by_name = COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME, ded.FULL_NAME, m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
          OR en.by_name = COALESCE(CONCAT_WS(' ', ed.FIRST_NAME, ed.LAST_NAME), CONCAT_WS(' ', ded.FIRST_NAME, ded.LAST_NAME), m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
     ))
ORDER BY instructor_name

rows.question: For each unique mailing list with a name beginning with R (case insensitive), and that Professor Ayden Hopkins is subscribed to, list its name, description, owner, number of people in the list, and number of tenured faculty in the list.

WITH person_directory_core AS (
  SELECT
    opa.FULL_NAME AS FULL_NAME,
    opa.PAYROLL_RANK AS PAYROLL_RANK,
    opa.MIT_ID AS PERSON_ID
  FROM opa_person_current opa
),
moira_lists_basic AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION AS list_description,
    mlo.OWNER AS list_owner
  FROM moira_list ml
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner mlo
    ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE
    ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST IN ('Y','y','1','true')
),
-- counts per list key: total subscribers and tenured faculty count
list_subscription_counts AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS total_subscribers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN opc.PAYROLL_RANK = 'Faculty Tenured' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tenured_faculty_count
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  LEFT JOIN opa_person_current opc
    ON opc.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
-- lists that Hopkins, Ayden is subscribed to (match by FULL_NAME in moira_list_detail member full name or by MIT_ID join if available)
hopkins_lists AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  LEFT JOIN person_directory_core pdc
    ON pdc.FULL_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  WHERE pdc.FULL_NAME = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
)
SELECT
  mlb.list_name AS list_name,
  mlb.list_description AS list_description,
  mlb.list_owner AS list_owner,
  COALESCE(lsc.total_subscribers, 0) AS total_subscribers,
  COALESCE(lsc.tenured_faculty_count, 0) AS tenured_faculty_count
FROM moira_lists_basic mlb
JOIN hopkins_lists hl
  ON hl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlb.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN list_subscription_counts lsc
  ON lsc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlb.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE UPPER(mlb.list_name) LIKE 'R%'

rows.question: For the building with the most floors, list the building name and the names of the mailing lists staring with a (case insensitive) that the building employees with kerberos starting with c (case insensitive) subscribe to.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- Find building(s) with the maximum BUILDING_COUNTER
max_floor_buildings AS (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NUMBER, BUILDING_NAME
  FROM buildings
  WHERE BUILDING_COUNTER = (SELECT MAX(BUILDING_COUNTER) FROM buildings)
),

-- Map employees to those building(s) by matching OFFICE_LOCATION to BUILDING_NUMBER or BUILDING_NAME (case-insensitive, permissive)
building_employee_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    mb.BUILDING_KEY,
    mb.BUILDING_NAME,
    mb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    d.MIT_ID,
    d.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    d.OFFICE_LOCATION
  FROM max_floor_buildings mb
  JOIN drupal_employee_directory d
    ON d.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
    AND (
         LOWER(d.OFFICE_LOCATION) = LOWER(mb.BUILDING_NAME)
      OR LOWER(d.OFFICE_LOCATION) = LOWER(mb.BUILDING_NUMBER)
      OR LOWER(d.OFFICE_LOCATION) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(mb.BUILDING_NAME), '%')
      OR (mb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND mb.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND LOWER(d.OFFICE_LOCATION) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(mb.BUILDING_NUMBER), '%'))
    )
),

-- canonical kerberos for each employee: prefer local-part of email, else MIT_ID; lowercased
employees_with_kerberos AS (
  SELECT
    bem.BUILDING_KEY,
    bem.BUILDING_NAME,
    bem.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    bem.MIT_ID,
    bem.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    bem.OFFICE_LOCATION,
    LOWER(
      CASE
        WHEN bem.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND bem.EMAIL_ADDRESS <> '' AND INSTR(bem.EMAIL_ADDRESS, '@') > 1
          THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(bem.EMAIL_ADDRESS, '@', 1)
        WHEN bem.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND bem.MIT_ID <> '' THEN bem.MIT_ID
        ELSE ''
      END
    ) AS canonical_kerberos
  FROM building_employee_mapping bem
),

-- Mail list subscriptions: join moira_list_detail and moira_list to get list names and member identifiers
moira_subscriptions AS (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  JOIN moira_list m
    ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
)

SELECT DISTINCT
  e.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MAILING_LIST_NAME
FROM employees_with_kerberos e
JOIN moira_subscriptions ml
  -- Match member to canonical kerberos case-insensitively.
  -- moira_list_detail may store either kerberos/email/local-part or MIT_ID; compare both.
  ON (
       (ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = e.canonical_kerberos)
    OR (ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) = LOWER(COALESCE(e.MIT_ID, '')))
    OR (
         ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL
      AND INSTR(ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '@') > 0
      AND LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '@', 1)) = e.canonical_kerberos
    )
  )
WHERE
  -- employees with kerberos starting with 'c' (case-insensitive)

rows.question: For the email lists subscribed by faculty members with last names begin with Y, list the names of the lists, the total number of subjects managed by faculty in those mailing lists, and the number of such faculty in the lists.

WITH y_faculty AS (
  -- faculty from Drupal directory whose last name starts with 'Y' (case-insensitive)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(`MIT_ID`) AS MIT_ID,
    `FULL_NAME`,
    `LAST_NAME`
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
  WHERE `LAST_NAME` IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(`LAST_NAME`) LIKE 'y%'
),
moira_members AS (
  -- active moira lists and their members (member MIT_IDs)
  SELECT
    ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
    LOWER(mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`) AS MEMBER_MIT_ID
  FROM `moira_list` ml
  JOIN `moira_list_detail` mld
    ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  WHERE ml.`IS_ACTIVE` = '1'
    -- assume MOIRA lists are indicated by having a non-null MOIRA_LIST_NAME;
    -- if additional filtering on name is desired (e.g., contains 'moira' or 'mit'),
    -- add: AND LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE '%moira%' OR LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE '%mit%'
),
y_faculty_on_lists AS (
  -- only the moira list memberships for faculty whose last name starts with Y
  SELECT
    mm.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    mm.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
    ym.MIT_ID
  FROM moira_members mm
  JOIN y_faculty ym
    ON mm.MEMBER_MIT_ID = ym.MIT_ID
),
faculty_managed_subjects AS (
  -- subjects a faculty is responsible for from either course_catalog_subject_offered or drupal_course_catalog
  -- normalize MIT_ID to lower for reliable joins
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`) AS MIT_ID,
    `SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND `SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`) AS MIT_ID,
    `SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
  WHERE `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND `SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  l.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS list_name,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT fms.`SUBJECT_ID`), 0) AS total_subjects_managed_by_faculty_in_list,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.MIT_ID) AS faculty_count_in_list
FROM (
  -- distinct faculty per list (one row per faculty per list)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
    `MIT_ID`
  FROM y_faculty_on_lists
) l
LEFT JOIN faculty_managed_subjects fms
  ON l.MIT_ID = fms.MIT_ID
GROUP BY l.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`
ORDER BY l.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` ASC

rows.question: For students with last names starting with H who are subscribed to mailing list 'beacon-date-date', list the names of the students, the phone numbers of departments they belong to, and the size of the mailing list 'beacon-date-date' that they are subscribed to.

WITH student_persons AS (

    `FULL_NAME` AS person_id,
    `LAST_NAME` AS last_name,
    `FIRST_NAME` AS first_name,
    `MIDDLE_NAME` AS middle_name,
    `DEPARTMENT` AS primary_department_id
  FROM `mit_student_directory`
),
moira_list_memberships AS (
  SELECT
    mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS MOIRA_LIST_ID,
    ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS MOIRA_PRINCIPAL,
    mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL_ID
  FROM `moira_list_detail` mld
  JOIN `moira_list` ml
    ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  WHERE ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` = 'beacon-date-date'
),
beacon_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS list_size
  FROM `moira_list_detail` mld
  JOIN `moira_list` ml
    ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  WHERE ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` = 'beacon-date-date'
)
SELECT
  -- requested student_full_name
  sp.person_id AS student_full_name,

  CONCAT_WS('', sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS department_phone_number,

rows.question: Give the count of mailing lists with names starting with B that include members from the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, along with the name of the list starting with B that have the highest number of members from that department and the corresponding member count of members associated with the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_members_130 AS (
SELECT
  `MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS `list_id`,
  `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS `member`
FROM
  `moira_list_detail`
),
moira_lists AS (
SELECT
  `moira_list`.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS `id`,
  -- normalize list name: preserve stored name column
  `moira_list`.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS `listname`,
  -- normalize mail system indicator: preserve stored indicator column
  `moira_list`.`IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST` AS `mail_system`
FROM
  `moira_list`
WHERE
  -- only mailing lists (literal filter is question-specific and should be lifted out;
  -- to return "All mailing lists from the Moira list metadata" we include rows
  -- regardless of active flag, but ensure we return rows that have a list key)
  `moira_list`.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` IS NOT NULL
),
moira_member_org_assignments AS (
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS list_id,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS member,
  f.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
FROM moira_list_detail AS m
LEFT JOIN se_person AS s
  ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = s.MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN fac_organization AS f
  ON s.ORGANIZATION = f.ORGANIZATION_KEY
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS count_of_lists_with_B_starting_names,
  COALESCE(top.listname, '') AS list_with_max_B_name,
  COALESCE(top.ee_cs_count, 0) AS max_member_count
FROM (
  SELECT ml.id AS list_id, ml.listname,
         COUNT(DISTINCT mla.member) AS ee_cs_count
  FROM moira_lists ml
  JOIN moira_list_members_130 lm ON lm.list_id = ml.id
  JOIN moira_member_org_assignments mla ON mla.list_id = lm.list_id AND mla.member = lm.member
  WHERE ml.mail_system = 'MOIRA'
    AND ml.listname LIKE 'B%'
    AND mla.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science'
  GROUP BY ml.id, ml.listname
) AS per_list
JOIN (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
      SELECT ml.id
      FROM moira_lists ml
      JOIN moira_list_members_130 lm ON lm.list_id = ml.id
      JOIN moira_member_org_assignments mla ON mla.list_id = lm.list_id AND mla.member = lm.member
      WHERE ml.mail_system = 'MOIRA'
        AND ml.listname LIKE 'B%'
        AND mla.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science'
      GROUP BY ml.id
    ) AS t
  ) AS t2
) AS total_counts ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT listname, ee_cs_count
  FROM (
    SELECT ml.id AS list_id, ml.listname,
           COUNT(DISTINCT mla.member) AS ee_cs_count
    FROM moira_lists ml
    JOIN moira_list_members_130 lm ON lm.list_id = ml.id
    JOIN moira_member_org_assignments mla ON mla.list_id = lm.list_id AND mla.member = lm.member
    WHERE ml.mail_system = 'MOIRA'
      AND ml.listname LIKE 'B%'
      AND mla.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science'
    GROUP BY ml.id, ml.listname
    ORDER BY ee_cs_count DESC, listname ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS top_one
) AS top ON 1=1

rows.question: For the 'kangaroo-inspire-yearn' email list, for each department present in the list, list the department name, the number of students in that department, and its percentage relative to the students in the mailing list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH list_students_with_department AS (
  SELECT
    m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS `list_name`,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS `mit_id`,
    -- Use the SIS student unique identifier: FULL_NAME is not ideal but mit_id is available from moira_list_detail
    -- include sis directory department info by joining on MIT_ID to warehouse_users if available, otherwise mit_student_directory
    COALESCE(wu.`UNIT_NAME`, s.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS `department_name`,
    -- carry a stable student identifier for DISTINCT counting
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS `student_key`
  FROM `moira_list_detail` d
  JOIN `moira_list` m
    ON d.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  -- restrict to members who appear to be students by presence in SIS directory or warehouse_users
  LEFT JOIN `mit_student_directory` s
    ON d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME` = s.`FULL_NAME`
  LEFT JOIN `warehouse_users` wu
    ON d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` = wu.`MIT_ID`
  WHERE m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` = 'kangaroo-inspire-yearn'
    -- ensure the member has an identifier that looks like a student (MIT_ID present) or appears in SIS directory
    AND (d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL OR s.`FULL_NAME` IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT
  `department_name` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `student_key`) AS STUDENT_COUNT,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT `student_key`) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT `student_key`)) OVER (), 0) * 100
  , 2) AS PERCENT_OF_LIST
FROM list_students_with_department
WHERE `department_name` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `department_name`
ORDER BY STUDENT_COUNT DESC

rows.question: For email lists subscribed by either support staff or faculty, list its name, the number of subscribers that are support staff, the number of subscribers that are faculty, as well as its active status.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_members_with_person_info AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    opc.ADMIN_EMPLOYEE_TYPE AS EMPLOYEE_TYPE,
    ml.IS_ACTIVE AS IS_ACTIVE
  FROM moira_list_detail AS mld
  JOIN moira_list AS ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  LEFT JOIN opa_person_current AS opc
    ON opc.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = '1' OR ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'true' OR ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y' OR ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'yes' OR ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 't' OR ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'TRUE'
),
-- keep a distinct (list,mit) pairing so duplicate subscriptions don't overcount
distinct_list_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    MIT_ID,
    EMPLOYEE_TYPE,
    IS_ACTIVE
  FROM moira_list_members_with_person_info
)
SELECT
  dlm.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dlm.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Support Staff' THEN dlm.MIT_ID END) AS support_staff_subscriber_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dlm.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Faculty' THEN dlm.MIT_ID END) AS faculty_subscriber_count,
  dlm.IS_ACTIVE AS active_status
FROM distinct_list_members AS dlm
GROUP BY
  dlm.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  dlm.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  dlm.IS_ACTIVE
HAVING
  support_staff_subscriber_count > 0
  OR faculty_subscriber_count > 0
ORDER BY
  dlm.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For the 'ocean-apple' mailing list, identify the department with the highest student count. Provide the department name, phone number, and the total number of students subscribed to the mailing list from that department. If multiple departments have the same highest count, list each one separately.

WITH ocean_subs AS (
  -- get subscriptions for the 'ocean-apple' list and associated subscriber MIT_IDs
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS mit_id
  FROM moira_list mlist
  JOIN moira_list_detail m
    ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlist.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE mlist.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'ocean-apple'
    AND m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) <> ''
),
-- identify which of those subscribers are students and bring their department code/name and phone
student_depts AS (
  SELECT
    s.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name,
    s.OFFICE_PHONE AS office_phone,
    s.DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    os.mit_id
  FROM ocean_subs os
  JOIN mit_student_directory s
    ON os.mit_id = s.FULL_NAME
  -- If mit_student_directory stored MIT_ID instead of FULL_NAME in your environment,
  -- replace join above with: ON os.mit_id = s.MIT_ID
),
-- fall back: if some mailing-list members are students recorded in employee-like tables (rare),
-- include any rows from drupal_employee_directory or employee_directory that indicate student status.
student_depts_extra AS (

    d.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name,
    d.OFFICE_PHONE AS office_phone,

  WHERE d.EMPLOYEE_GROUP = 'Student' OR d.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student'
),
all_student_depts AS (

  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM student_depts_extra
)

  ad.office_phone AS OFFICE_PHONE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad.mit_id) AS STUDENT_COUNT
FROM all_student_depts ad
WHERE ad.department_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(ad.department_name) <> ''
GROUP BY ad.department_name, ad.office_phone
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ad.mit_id) = (
  SELECT MAX(dept_count) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) AS dept_count
    FROM all_student_depts
    WHERE department_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(department_name) <> ''
    GROUP BY department_name, office_phone
  ) q
)
ORDER BY STUDENT_COUNT DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: For each mailing group, list its owner, owner type, the member visibility ('Public Members' if public, and 'Hidden Members' otherwise), and the number of members of this type of visibility. For each owner and owner type, include a grand total for all members in the format of (owner, owner type, null, total members).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH member_counts_totals_per_owner AS (
  SELECT
    mlo.`OWNER` AS OWNER,
    (CASE WHEN ml.`IS_MOIRA_GROUP` = 'Y' THEN 'MOIRA' ELSE mlo.`OWNER_TYPE` END) AS OWNER_TYPE,
    COUNT(mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`) AS total_member_count
  FROM moira_list ml
  JOIN moira_list_owner mlo
    ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mlo.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  GROUP BY
    mlo.`OWNER`,
    (CASE WHEN ml.`IS_MOIRA_GROUP` = 'Y' THEN 'MOIRA' ELSE mlo.`OWNER_TYPE` END)
)
SELECT
  mlo.`OWNER` AS owner,
  (CASE WHEN ml.`IS_MOIRA_GROUP` = 'Y' THEN 'MOIRA' ELSE mlo.`OWNER_TYPE` END) AS owner_type,
  (CASE WHEN ml.`IS_PUBLIC` = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END) AS member_visibility,
  COUNT(mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`) AS member_count
FROM
  moira_list ml
JOIN
  moira_list_owner mlo
  ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mlo.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`
LEFT JOIN
  moira_list_detail mld
  ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
GROUP BY
  mlo.`OWNER`,
  (CASE WHEN ml.`IS_MOIRA_GROUP` = 'Y' THEN 'MOIRA' ELSE mlo.`OWNER_TYPE` END),
  (CASE WHEN ml.`IS_PUBLIC` = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  mcto.OWNER AS owner,
  mcto.OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type,
  NULL AS member_visibility,
  mcto.total_member_count AS member_count
FROM
  member_counts_totals_per_owner mcto
ORDER BY
  owner ASC,
  owner_type ASC,
  CASE
    WHEN member_visibility = 'Public Members' THEN 1
    WHEN member_visibility = 'Hidden Members' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END ASC

rows.question: Group biology courses by cluster type and course level. For each group, list the name of the department, the course title, cluster type, total enrollments, average enrollment within its cluster, course level, number of unique course materials, average new and used prices for TIP materials, total material record count for TIP materials, number of unique library titles, and number of unique library ISBNs.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_materials_by_course AS (
  SELECT
    tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY    AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY            AS MATERIAL_ID,
    tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE        AS SOURCE,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE             AS NEW_PRICE,
    tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE            AS USED_PRICE,
    td.RECORD_COUNT                AS RECORD_COUNT
  FROM tip_material tm
  JOIN tip_detail td
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN tip_subject_offered tso
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
library_links_by_course AS (
  SELECT
    lmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    lc.CATALOG_TITLE                AS LIBRARY_TITLE,
    lc.CATALOG_ISBN                 AS LIBRARY_ISBN,
    lmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY AS MATRL_DETAIL_ID
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lmd
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lc
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
),
cm_agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MATERIAL_ID) AS unique_course_materials,
    AVG(NEW_PRICE) AS avg_new_price_tip,
    AVG(USED_PRICE) AS avg_used_price_tip,
    SUM(COALESCE(RECORD_COUNT,0)) AS total_tip_material_records,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SOURCE = 'TIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tip_source_rows
  FROM course_materials_by_course
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID
),
lib_agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_TITLE) AS unique_library_titles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_ISBN) AS unique_library_isbns
  FROM library_links_by_course
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID
)
SELECT
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
  s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  s.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS total_enrollments,
  AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY s.CLUSTER_TYPE) AS avg_enrollment_in_cluster,
  s.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_level,
  COALESCE(cm.unique_course_materials,0) AS unique_course_materials,
  COALESCE(cm.avg_new_price_tip,0) AS avg_new_price_tip,
  COALESCE(cm.avg_used_price_tip,0) AS avg_used_price_tip,
  COALESCE(cm.total_tip_material_records,0) AS total_tip_material_records,
  COALESCE(lib.unique_library_titles,0) AS unique_library_titles,
  COALESCE(lib.unique_library_isbns,0) AS unique_library_isbns
FROM subject_offered_summary s
LEFT JOIN cm_agg cm
  ON cm.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID = s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN lib_agg lib
  ON lib.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID = s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
WHERE s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'
ORDER BY s.CLUSTER_TYPE, s.COURSE_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

rows.question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.
