WITH instructor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    -- normalize separators to commas and aggregate distinct instructor strings per subject
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ';', ','), ',,', ',')), '') SEPARATOR ',') AS ALL_FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ';', ','), ',,', ',')), '') SEPARATOR ',') AS ALL_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
  GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID
),
nums AS (
  SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
  UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
  UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
  UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24
  UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29
  UNION ALL SELECT 30 UNION ALL SELECT 31 UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34
  UNION ALL SELECT 35 UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39
  UNION ALL SELECT 40 UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44
  UNION ALL SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47 UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dhi.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS department_name,
  cc.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  cc.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
  cc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  cc.GRADE_TYPE AS course_level,       -- course level isn't present as COURSE_LEVEL in this table; use GRADE_TYPE if COURSE_LEVEL not present
  cc.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units,
  CASE
    WHEN cc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall'
    WHEN cc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Spring'
    WHEN cc.TERM_CODE LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(cc.TERM_CODE,1,4),'FA') THEN 'Fall'
    WHEN cc.TERM_CODE LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(cc.TERM_CODE,1,4),'SP') THEN 'Spring'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS term,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(s_i), ''))
    FROM (
      SELECT
        TRIM(
          SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(ia.ALL_FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums.n+1),
          ',', -1)
        ) AS s_i
      FROM instructor_agg ia
      JOIN nums ON 1=1
      WHERE ia.SUBJECT_ID = cc.SUBJECT_ID
        AND ia.ALL_FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
        AND ia.ALL_FALL_INSTRUCTORS <> ''
        AND nums.n < (LENGTH(ia.ALL_FALL_INSTRUCTORS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ia.ALL_FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', '')) + 1)
    ) x
  ) AS fall_instructor_count,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(s_i), ''))
    FROM (
      SELECT
        TRIM(
          SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(ia.ALL_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums.n+1),
          ',', -1)
        ) AS s_i
      FROM instructor_agg ia
      JOIN nums ON 1=1
      WHERE ia.SUBJECT_ID = cc.SUBJECT_ID
        AND ia.ALL_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
        AND ia.ALL_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS <> ''
        AND nums.n < (LENGTH(ia.ALL_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ia.ALL_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', '')) + 1)
    ) x
  ) AS spring_instructor_count
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc
LEFT JOIN fac_organization dhi
  ON cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dhi.D_CODE
LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all at
  ON cc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE OR cc.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN instructor_agg ia
  ON cc.SUBJECT_ID = ia.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE cc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
  AND (cc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR cc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
  AND cc.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  department_name,
  school_name,
  cc.SUBJECT_ID,
  cc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  course_level,
  cc.TOTAL_UNITS,
  term,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY department_name, cc.SUBJECT_ID

rows.question: For Political Science courses with HASS attributes, for each attribute, list the name and description of the attribute, the number of unique subjects, average units, the total enrollment, the number of departments that grant degrees, and the subject code description.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH cis_hass_attr_dim AS (
  SELECT
    `HASS_ATTRIBUTE`,
    `DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN`
  FROM `cis_hass_attribute`
),
-- subjects from the catalog with HASS and in Political Science department
cis_course_subjects_with_hass AS (
  SELECT
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `HASS_ATTRIBUTE`,
    `TOTAL_UNITS`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
  FROM `cis_course_catalog`
  WHERE `HASS_ATTRIBUTE` IS NOT NULL
    AND `HASS_ATTRIBUTE` <> ''
    AND `DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Political Science'
),
-- department degree-granting flags for departments referenced by subjects
dept_flags AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
  FROM `sis_department`
),
-- enrollment per subject: schema does not provide enrollment columns, so return 0 per instructions
-- attempt to collect section-level rows if available in course_catalog_subject_offered or drupal_course_catalog,
-- but since no explicit ENROLLMENT column exists in the schema, produce 0.
section_enrollments_by_subject AS (
  SELECT
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    0 AS ENROLLMENT
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Political Science'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    0 AS ENROLLMENT
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
  WHERE `DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Political Science'
)
SELECT
  c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  d.`DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN` AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.`SUBJECT_CODE`) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
  -- average TOTAL_UNITS across distinct SUBJECT_CODE; ignore NULLs by using AVG on derived per-subject totals
  AVG(per_subject.avg_total_units) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  -- total enrollment summed across section rows (will be 0 if no enrollment data present)
  COALESCE(SUM(se.total_enrollment), 0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  -- count distinct department codes among these subjects where department is degree-granting = 'Y'
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN df.`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` = 'Y' THEN c.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` END) AS NUM_DEGREE_GRANTING_DEPARTMENTS,
  -- subject title/description: concatenate distinct subject titles for the group
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.`SUBJECT_TITLE` ORDER BY c.`SUBJECT_TITLE` SEPARATOR '; ') AS SUBJECT_TITLE
FROM cis_course_subjects_with_hass c
LEFT JOIN cis_hass_attr_dim d
  ON c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` = d.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`
LEFT JOIN dept_flags df
  ON c.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = df.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`
-- per-subject aggregation to compute avg over subjects (ignore NULL TOTAL_UNITS)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    -- also expose a representative TOTAL_UNITS per subject if needed
    SUM(CASE WHEN TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL THEN TOTAL_UNITS ELSE 0 END) AS sum_total_units
  FROM cis_course_subjects_with_hass
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE
) per_subject
  ON c.`SUBJECT_CODE` = per_subject.`SUBJECT_CODE`
-- enrollments per subject (will sum zeros given schema)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUM(ENROLLMENT) AS total_enrollment
  FROM section_enrollments_by_subject
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE
) se
  ON c.`SUBJECT_CODE` = se.`SUBJECT_CODE`
GROUP BY c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`, d.`DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN`
ORDER BY c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`

rows.question: Group subjects by cluster type, department offering the subject, and the school name. For each group, list the cluster type, name of the department, school name, whether the department grants degrees, total number of subjects, total enrollment, and average enrollment. Exclude clusters or schools with no student data.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, ss.CLUSTER_TYPE, so.CLUSTER_TYPE) AS cluster_type,
  COALESCE(sis.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS department_name,
  COALESCE(sis.SCHOOL_NAME, sg.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name,
  CASE
    WHEN sis.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING IS NOT NULL THEN
      CASE WHEN UPPER(sis.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS department_grants_degrees,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(sos.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY, ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY, so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY, sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, so.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_ID)) AS subject_count,
  SUM(
    COALESCE(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)
  ) AS total_enrollment,
  ROUND(
    SUM(COALESCE(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0))
    / NULLIF(
        COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(sos.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY, ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY, so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY, sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, so.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_ID))
      , 0)
  , 2) AS average_enrollment
FROM subject_offered_summary sos
LEFT JOIN subject_summary ss
  ON sos.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
  ON sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN subject_grouping sg
  ON sos.SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY = sg.SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY
LEFT JOIN sis_department sis
  ON COALESCE(sg.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE) = sis.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE COALESCE(sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, ss.CLUSTER_TYPE, so.CLUSTER_TYPE) IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(sis.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(sis.SCHOOL_NAME, sg.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME) IS NOT NULL
  -- require at least some enrollment for the subject rows joined
  AND (
       (sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0)
    OR (ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0)
    OR (so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL AND so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0)
  )
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, ss.CLUSTER_TYPE, so.CLUSTER_TYPE),
  COALESCE(sis.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME),
  COALESCE(sis.SCHOOL_NAME, sg.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME),
  CASE
    WHEN sis.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING IS NOT NULL THEN
      CASE WHEN UPPER(sis.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC

rows.question: For each course, provide the room number of course location, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, room usage, term code, course level, the total number of subjects, unique meeting times, and total units. Do not include meet place or meet times with NULL values.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  so.MEET_PLACE AS room_number,
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NAME, fclt_b.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name,
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, fclt_b.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS building_number,
  COALESCE(fbad.CITY, fclt_bad.CITY, fbaddr.CITY) AS building_city,
  COALESCE(fbad.STATE, fclt_bad.STATE, fbaddr.STATE) AS building_state,
  fr.AREA AS area,
  COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS organization_name,
  COALESCE(fr.USE_DESC, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, zrl.SPACE_USAGE) AS room_usage,
  so.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  CASE
    WHEN so.COURSE_NUMBER LIKE '1%' THEN '1000'
    WHEN so.COURSE_NUMBER LIKE '2%' THEN '2000'
    WHEN so.COURSE_NUMBER LIKE '3%' THEN '3000'
    WHEN so.COURSE_NUMBER LIKE '4%' THEN '4000'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS course_level,
  ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS total_subjects,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.MEET_TIME)
   FROM subject_offered t
   WHERE t.MEET_PLACE = so.MEET_PLACE
     AND t.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
     AND t.MEET_TIME <> '') AS unique_meeting_times,
  ssum.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
FROM subject_offered so
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN buildings b ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fclt_b ON fclt_b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fbad ON fbad.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fclt_bad ON fclt_bad.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fclt_b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fbaddr ON fbaddr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr ON fr.ROOM = so.MEET_PLACE OR fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN zpm_rooms_load zrl ON zrl.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = fr.FLOOR
LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo ON fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY
LEFT JOIN subject_summary ss ON ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary ssum ON ssum.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
WHERE so.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
  AND so.MEET_PLACE <> ''
  AND so.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND so.MEET_TIME <> ''

rows.question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- Aggregate per catalog item: determine material status, department name, and sum of enrolled students from linked SIS courses.
catalog_item_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS CATALOG_ID,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    -- derive a department name: prefer fac_organization HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME if we can join via subject_offered's OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    -- otherwise fall back to library_subject_offered.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, else label as 'Unspecified Department'
    COALESCE(fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, 'Unspecified Department') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- sum enrolled students from subject_offered rows linked to this catalog item; if none, contribute 0
    COALESCE(SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
  -- link reserve detail to catalog items
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail rmd
    ON rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  -- link to library_subject_offered (may be NULL)
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  -- link to material status table (may be NULL)
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  -- link to subject_offered (SIS) to get enrollment; try matching subject identifiers where available.
  -- The schema doesn't provide a direct guaranteed FK, but subject_offered has SUBJECT_ID and SECTION_ID; library_subject_offered has SUBJECT_ID too.
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
    ON (
         -- prefer matching by library_subject_offered key -> subject_offered may also expose same SUBJECT_ID and TERM_CODE;
         -- try to join by SUBJECT_ID and TERM_CODE where available
         (lso.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID)
         OR
         (rmd.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = rmd.SUBJECT_ID)
       )
  -- attempt to find HR department name via fac_organization using OFFER_DEPT_CODE present on library_subject_offered or subject_offered
  LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo
    ON fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
       AND (
            (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME)
            OR (so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME)
           )
  GROUP BY
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
    COALESCE(fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME)
),

-- Filter catalog items to those cataloged in year >= 2000.
catalog_items_after_2000 AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS CATALOG_ID
  FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
  WHERE
    (
      -- attempt to parse full date/time
      (STR_TO_DATE(lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') IS NOT NULL
        AND STR_TO_DATE(lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2000-01-01')
      OR
      (STR_TO_DATE(lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') IS NOT NULL
        AND STR_TO_DATE(lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= '2000-01-01')
      OR
      -- fallback if year stored separately in CATALOG_YEAR column
      (lrc.CATALOG_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS SIGNED) >= 2000)
    )
  GROUP BY lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
)

-- Main report: detail rows (per material status + department), subtotal per material status, and grand total
SELECT
  MATERIAL_STATUS,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
  TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM (
  -- Detail rows
  SELECT
    cie.MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    cie.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cie.CATALOG_ID) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    SUM(cie.ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    0 AS row_kind,
    cie.MATERIAL_STATUS AS sort_status,
    cie.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sort_dept
  FROM catalog_item_enrollment cie
  JOIN catalog_items_after_2000 c2000 ON c2000.CATALOG_ID = cie.CATALOG_ID
  GROUP BY cie.MATERIAL_STATUS, cie.DEPARTMENT_NAME

  UNION ALL

  -- Subtotals per MATERIAL_STATUS
  SELECT
    cie.MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    'Subtotal' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cie.CATALOG_ID) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    SUM(cie.ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    1 AS row_kind,
    cie.MATERIAL_STATUS AS sort_status,
    '' AS sort_dept
  FROM catalog_item_enrollment cie
  JOIN catalog_items_after_2000 c2000 ON c2000.CATALOG_ID = cie.CATALOG_ID
  GROUP BY cie.MATERIAL_STATUS

  UNION ALL

  -- Grand total
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    'Grand Total' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cie.CATALOG_ID) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    SUM(cie.ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    2 AS row_kind,
    NULL AS sort_status,
    '' AS sort_dept
  FROM catalog_item_enrollment cie
  JOIN catalog_items_after_2000 c2000 ON c2000.CATALOG_ID = cie.CATALOG_ID
) t
ORDER BY
  -- ensure per-material_status blocks, with detail rows ordered by department, then subtotal, and final grand total last
  CASE WHEN MATERIAL_STATUS = 'Grand Total' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
  sort_status,
  MATERIAL_STATUS,
  sort_dept

rows.question: For each course with enrolled students and with books in the library system, list the name of the department of that course, total number of courses using library materials, the number of catalog items associated with those courses, and the average enrollment per course. Include a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field should be 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH department_course_catalog_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    so.SECTION_ID AS section_id,
    COALESCE(fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
    so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS enrollment_total,
    lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS catalog_item_key
  FROM subject_offered AS so
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail AS lrmd
    ON lrmd.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
    AND lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
    AND lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
      -- note: LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY relationship may vary by data; keep join on term+subject as primary link
  JOIN library_reserve_catalog AS lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_organization AS fo
    ON so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD
  WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL
    AND so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
    AND lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
-- collapse to one row per distinct course (subject+section) and collect distinct catalog items per course
course_level AS (
  SELECT
    department_name,
    subject_id,
    section_id,
    MAX(enrollment_total) AS enrollment_per_course,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT catalog_item_key) AS catalog_ids_concat
  FROM department_course_catalog_enrollment
  GROUP BY department_name, subject_id, section_id
),
-- helper numbers for splitting GROUP_CONCAT (supports up to 50 items; extend if necessary)
numbers AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
  UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25
  UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL SELECT 30
  UNION ALL SELECT 31 UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL SELECT 35
  UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39 UNION ALL SELECT 40
  UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL SELECT 45
  UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47 UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49 UNION ALL SELECT 50
),
-- expand catalog ids so we can count distinct catalog items per department without double-counting duplicates across sections
course_catalog_expanded AS (
  SELECT
    c.department_name,
    c.subject_id,
    c.section_id,
    c.enrollment_per_course,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.catalog_ids_concat, ',', n.n), ',', -1)) AS catalog_item_key
  FROM course_level c
  JOIN numbers n
    ON n.n <= 1 + LENGTH(c.catalog_ids_concat) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.catalog_ids_concat, ',', ''))
  WHERE c.catalog_ids_concat IS NOT NULL AND c.catalog_ids_concat <> ''
),
dept_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(subject_id, '||', section_id)) AS course_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_item_key) AS catalog_item_count,
    SUM(enrollment_per_course) AS total_enrollment
  FROM course_catalog_expanded
  GROUP BY department_name
)
SELECT
  department_name AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  course_count AS COURSE_COUNT,
  catalog_item_count AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
  ROUND(total_enrollment / NULLIF(course_count,0), 2) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT_PER_COURSE
FROM dept_aggregates

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SUM(course_count) AS COURSE_COUNT,

FROM dept_aggregates

  CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,

rows.question: For each department and school offering courses with materials, list the department name, school name, number of unique course materials, number of courses, average new and used shelf prices of materials, total material records, and number of distinct material statuses. Include a grand total across all schools and departments (the corresponding school and department fields should be null).

WITH department_school_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORG_UNITS_ID,
    fac_organization.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    fac_organization.MAJOR_ORG AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM fac_organization
),
courses_with_materials_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS SUBJ_OFFER_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJ_CODE,
    COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUM,
    TERM_CODE AS TERM_ID,
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPT_ID,
    OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME_RAW
  FROM tip_subject_offered
  WHERE IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'
),
materials_by_course AS (
  -- join courses that have materials to the detail and material tables
  SELECT
    cwm.SUBJ_OFFER_ID,
    cwm.DEPT_ID,
    COALESCE(dsl.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(dsl.SCHOOL_NAME, cwm.SCHOOL_NAME_RAW, NULL) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    td.RECORD_COUNT,
    -- ensure numeric prices; non-numeric will become NULL
    NULLIF(TRIM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE), '') AS NEW_SHELF_PRICE_RAW,
    NULLIF(TRIM(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE), '') AS USED_SHELF_PRICE_RAW,
    -- cast strings to decimal safely: use NULLIF + CAST when numeric, else NULL
    CASE
      WHEN tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS DECIMAL(18,4))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS NEW_SHELF_PRICE_NUM,
    CASE
      WHEN tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE AS DECIMAL(18,4))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS USED_SHELF_PRICE_NUM
  FROM courses_with_materials_cohort cwm
  LEFT JOIN department_school_lookup dsl
    ON cwm.DEPT_ID = dsl.ORG_UNITS_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = cwm.SUBJ_OFFER_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
)

  SCHOOL_NAME,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS NUM_UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIALS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJ_OFFER_ID) AS NUM_COURSES,

  AVG(NEW_SHELF_PRICE_NUM) AS AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  AVG(USED_SHELF_PRICE_NUM) AS AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(RECORD_COUNT, 0)), 0) AS TOTAL_MATERIAL_RECORDS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS NUM_DISTINCT_MATERIAL_STATUSES
FROM materials_by_course
GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

UNION ALL

-- grand total row: nulls for school and department
SELECT

  NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS NUM_UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIALS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJ_OFFER_ID) AS NUM_COURSES,
  AVG(NEW_SHELF_PRICE_NUM) AS AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  AVG(USED_SHELF_PRICE_NUM) AS AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(RECORD_COUNT, 0)), 0) AS TOTAL_MATERIAL_RECORDS,

FROM materials_by_course

ORDER BY

rows.question: For each TIP material status, list the total number of unique materials associated with the status, the total number of records associated with the status, and the total student enrollment associated with the status. Any material status with null values should be displayed as 'No material status'. Additionally, include a grand total across all material status (the material status for this row should be displayed as 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH tip_material_rows AS (
  SELECT
    m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS MATERIAL_ID,
    s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    -- Use RECORD_COUNT from tip_detail as the count of records for that detail row; if NULL treat as 0
    COALESCE(d.RECORD_COUNT, 0) AS RECORD_COUNT,
    -- Use NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS from tip_subject_offered as student enrollment; treat NULL as 0
    COALESCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS STUDENT_ENROLLMENT
  FROM tip_material AS m
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail AS d
    ON m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status AS s
    ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered AS tso
    ON d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
)
SELECT
  material_status,
  UNIQUE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
  RECORD_COUNT,
  TOTAL_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT
FROM (
  SELECT
    -- label NULL statuses as 'No material status'
    CASE WHEN MATERIAL_STATUS IS NULL THEN 'No material status' ELSE MATERIAL_STATUS END AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MATERIAL_ID) AS UNIQUE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
    SUM(RECORD_COUNT) AS RECORD_COUNT,
    SUM(STUDENT_ENROLLMENT) AS TOTAL_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT,
    0 AS sort_grand -- normal rows sort before grand total marker
  FROM tip_material_rows
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN MATERIAL_STATUS IS NULL THEN 'No material status' ELSE MATERIAL_STATUS END

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MATERIAL_ID) AS UNIQUE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
    SUM(RECORD_COUNT) AS RECORD_COUNT,
    SUM(STUDENT_ENROLLMENT) AS TOTAL_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT,
    1 AS sort_grand -- ensure grand total sorts last
  FROM tip_material_rows
) t
ORDER BY
  sort_grand,                  -- keep regular statuses first (0), grand total last (1)
  -- for regular statuses, order alphabetically with 'No material status' included
  CASE WHEN sort_grand = 1 THEN NULL ELSE material_status END

rows.question: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number, ownership type, organization name, number of rooms, area, and percentage of area relative to the building. Include subtotals across floors, subtotals across all floors for each building, and a grand total across all buildings. For the subtotal for each building and the grand total, the percentage of area should be relative to area of all buildings. All numeric values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators except the relative percentages which should be rounded to two decimal places.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  'csv' AS csv
UNION ALL
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(line SEPARATOR '\n') FROM (
  WITH room_rows AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbl.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name,
      COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, sf.FLOOR, fd.FLOOR) AS floor,
      COALESCE(fr.ROOM, fr.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, fd.ROOM) AS room_number,
      COALESCE(fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, fbl.OWNERSHIP_TYPE) AS ownership_type,
      COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS organization_name,
      1 AS num_rooms,
      COALESCE(fr.AREA, fbh.AREA, fd.AREA, 0) AS area
    FROM fclt_rooms fr
    LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
    LEFT JOIN fac_building fbl ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbl.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
    LEFT JOIN buildings b ON (fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER OR fbl.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER)
    LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms_hist fbh ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = fbh.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
    LEFT JOIN fclt_organization_hist fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
    LEFT JOIN space_detail sd ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM
    LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fd ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = fd.FAC_ROOM_KEY

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fbl2.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name,
      COALESCE(sf2.FLOOR, NULL) AS floor,
      zr.BUILDING_ROOM AS room_number,
      NULL AS ownership_type,
      NULL AS organization_name,
      1 AS num_rooms,
      0 AS area
    FROM zpm_rooms_load zr
    LEFT JOIN buildings b ON zr.BUILDING_COMPONENT = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
    LEFT JOIN fac_building fbl2 ON zr.BUILDING_COMPONENT = fbl2.BUILDING_NUMBER
    LEFT JOIN space_floor sf2 ON zr.FLOOR = sf2.FLOOR
  ),
  agg AS (
    SELECT
      building_name,
      IFNULL(floor,'(No Floor)') AS floor,
      IFNULL(room_number,'(No Room)') AS room_number,
      IFNULL(ownership_type,'(No Ownership)') AS ownership_type,
      IFNULL(organization_name,'(No Org)') AS organization_name,
      SUM(num_rooms) AS rooms,
      ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(area,0))) AS area_int
    FROM room_rows
    GROUP BY building_name, floor, room_number, ownership_type, organization_name
  ),
  building_totals AS (
    SELECT
      building_name,
      SUM(rooms) AS building_rooms,
      SUM(area_int) AS building_area
    FROM agg
    GROUP BY building_name
  ),
  grand AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(building_rooms) AS grand_rooms,
      SUM(building_area) AS grand_area
    FROM building_totals
  ),
  formatted_rows AS (
    SELECT
      a.building_name,
      a.floor,
      a.room_number,
      a.ownership_type,
      a.organization_name,
      FORMAT(a.rooms,0) AS rooms_fmt,
      FORMAT(a.area_int,0) AS area_fmt,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(bt.building_area,0) > 0
           THEN FORMAT(ROUND(a.area_int / bt.building_area * 100, 2), 2)
           ELSE '0.00' END AS pct_of_building,
      bt.building_area,
      gr.grand_area,
      a.rooms,
      a.area_int
    FROM agg a
    LEFT JOIN building_totals bt ON a.building_name = bt.building_name
    CROSS JOIN grand gr
  ),
  lines_individual AS (
    SELECT
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(building_name,'(No Building)'), ',', 
        COALESCE(floor,''), ',', 
        COALESCE(room_number,''), ',', 
        COALESCE(ownership_type,''), ',', 
        COALESCE(organization_name,''), ',', 
        rooms_fmt, ',', 
        area_fmt, ',', 
        COALESCE(pct_of_building,'0.00')
      ) AS line,
      building_name,
      floor,
      1 AS seq,
      building_name AS sort_building,
      floor AS sort_floor,
      room_number AS sort_room
    FROM formatted_rows
  ),
  floor_subs AS (
    SELECT
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(fr.building_name,'(No Building)'), ',',
        COALESCE(fr.floor,''), ',',
        '(Floor Subtotal)', ',',
        ',', 
        ',', 
        FORMAT(SUM(fr.rooms),0), ',',
        FORMAT(SUM(fr.area_int),0), ',',
        CASE WHEN bt.building_area > 0 THEN FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(fr.area_int) / bt.building_area * 100,2),2) ELSE '0.00' END
      ) AS line,
      fr.building_name,
      fr.floor,
      2 AS seq,
      fr.building_name AS sort_building,
      fr.floor AS sort_floor,
      NULL AS sort_room
    FROM formatted_rows fr
    LEFT JOIN building_totals bt ON fr.building_name = bt.building_name
    GROUP BY fr.building_name, fr.floor
  ),
  building_subs AS (
    SELECT
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(bt.building_name,'(No Building)'), ',',
        '(Building Subtotal)', ',',
        ',', 
        ',', 
        FORMAT(bt.building_rooms,0), ',',
        FORMAT(bt.building_area,0), ',',
        CASE WHEN gr.grand_area > 0 THEN FORMAT(ROUND(bt.building_area / gr.grand_area * 100,2),2) ELSE '0.00' END
      ) AS line,
      bt.building_name,
      NULL AS floor,
      3 AS seq,
      bt.building_name AS sort_building,
      '~' AS sort_floor,
      NULL AS sort_room
    FROM building_totals bt
    CROSS JOIN grand gr
  ),
  grand_sub AS (
    SELECT
      CONCAT(
        '(Grand Total)', ',',
        ',',',',',',
        FORMAT(gr.grand_rooms,0), ',',
        FORMAT(gr.grand_area,0), ',',
        CASE WHEN gr.grand_area > 0 THEN FORMAT(ROUND(gr.grand_area / gr.grand_area * 100,2),2) ELSE '0.00' END
      ) AS line,
      NULL AS building_name,
      NULL AS floor,
      4 AS seq,
      '~' AS sort_building,
      '~' AS sort_floor,
      NULL AS sort_room
    FROM grand gr
  )
  SELECT line, building_name, floor, seq FROM (
    SELECT line, building_name, floor, seq, sort_building, sort_floor, sort_room FROM lines_individual
    UNION ALL
    SELECT line, building_name, floor, seq, sort_building, sort_floor, sort_room FROM floor_subs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT line, building_name, floor, seq, sort_building, sort_floor, sort_room FROM building_subs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT line, building_name, floor, seq, sort_building, sort_floor, sort_room FROM grand_sub
  ) t
  ORDER BY
    COALESCE(sort_building,'~'),
    COALESCE(sort_floor,'~'),
    seq,
    COALESCE(sort_room,'')
) x

    AND `academic_terms`.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` IS NOT NULL
    AND `academic_terms`.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` <> ''
    AND NOT (
      (`academic_terms`.`TERM_START_DATE` IS NULL OR `academic_terms`.`TERM_START_DATE` = '')
      AND
      (`academic_terms`.`TERM_END_DATE`   IS NULL OR `academic_terms`.`TERM_END_DATE`   = '')

-- fallback keys for fiscal periods / quarters: use TERM_SELECTOR for fiscal periods,
-- TERM_CODE for quarters (per instructions when explicit columns absent)
fiscal_period_and_quarter_keys AS (

    at.TERM_SELECTOR AS TERM_SELECTOR,
    at.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR AS TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR

)

rows.question: Group buildings by campus sectors. For each group, list the campus sector, name of the building, city and state where the building is located, total number of floors, total assignable area, total number of rooms, total number of organizations, ownership type, and a rank column indicating the order (1-indexed) of this row within each sector based on the descending order of assignable area. Include subtotals for each sector and a grand total across all sectors. The subtotal and grand total only need to computed over the total number of floors and assignable area.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_basic AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_CODE,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    fba.CITY AS CITY,
    fba.STATE AS STATE,
    fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  FROM fac_building fb
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
    AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'PRIMARY'
  WHERE fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NOT NULL AND fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR <> ''
),
floors_per_building AS (
  -- count distinct floors per building (use fac_floor.BUILDING_KEY)
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR) AS total_floors
  FROM fac_floor
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
),
assignable_per_building AS (
  -- prefer buildings.BUILDING_NUMBER matching fac_building.BUILDING_NUMBER (fac_building key is FAC_BUILDING_KEY)
  -- fac_building.BUILDING_NUMBER isn't selected above, so match by FAC_BUILDING_KEY to buildings.BUILDING_NUMBER is not possible.
  -- Use fac_building table's BLDG_ASSIGNABLE if present: fac_building has BLDG_ASSIGNABLE? It has BLDG fields named BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE only in 'buildings' table.
  -- Best available: use buildings table by joining on BUILDING_NUMBER via fac_building.BUILDING_NUMBER. So bring BUILDING_NUMBER from fac_building.
  SELECT b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,0)),0) AS total_assignable_area
  FROM buildings b
  GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NUMBER
),
rooms_orgs_per_building AS (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ROOM) AS total_rooms,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations
  FROM fac_rooms
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
),
-- building-level rows including rank and sector sums
building_rows AS (
  SELECT
    bb.CAMPUS_SECTOR AS campus_sector,
    bb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    bb.CITY AS city,
    bb.STATE AS state,
    COALESCE(fp.total_floors, 0) AS total_floors,
    -- match assignable area: try matching fac_building.BUILDING_NUMBER to buildings.BUILDING_NUMBER by looking up via fac_building table
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT apb.total_assignable_area
       FROM assignable_per_building apb
       JOIN fac_building fb2 ON fb2.BUILDING_NUMBER = apb.BUILDING_NUMBER
       WHERE fb2.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = bb.BUILDING_CODE
       LIMIT 1),
      0
    ) AS total_assignable_area,
    COALESCE(ro.total_rooms, NULL) AS total_rooms,
    COALESCE(ro.total_organizations, NULL) AS total_organizations,
    bb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ownership_type
  FROM building_basic bb
  LEFT JOIN floors_per_building fp ON fp.BUILDING_KEY = bb.BUILDING_CODE
  LEFT JOIN rooms_orgs_per_building ro ON ro.BUILDING_KEY = bb.BUILDING_CODE
),
ranked_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    br.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY br.campus_sector ORDER BY COALESCE(br.total_assignable_area,0) DESC) AS sector_rank,
    SUM(COALESCE(br.total_floors,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY br.campus_sector) AS sector_sum_floors,
    SUM(COALESCE(br.total_assignable_area,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY br.campus_sector) AS sector_sum_assignable
  FROM building_rows br
)
-- final union: building rows, per-sector subtotal, grand total
SELECT
  campus_sector,
  building_name,
  city,
  state,
  total_floors,
  total_assignable_area,
  total_rooms,
  total_organizations,
  ownership_type,
  sector_rank AS sector_rank
FROM ranked_buildings

UNION ALL

-- Subtotals per sector
SELECT
  campus_sector,
  'SUBTOTAL' AS building_name,
  NULL AS city,
  NULL AS state,
  SUM(COALESCE(total_floors,0)) AS total_floors,
  SUM(COALESCE(total_assignable_area,0)) AS total_assignable_area,
  NULL AS total_rooms,
  NULL AS total_organizations,
  NULL AS ownership_type,
  NULL AS sector_rank
FROM ranked_buildings
GROUP BY campus_sector

UNION ALL

-- Grand total row
SELECT
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS campus_sector,
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS building_name,
  NULL AS city,
  NULL AS state,
  SUM(COALESCE(total_floors,0)) AS total_floors,
  SUM(COALESCE(total_assignable_area,0)) AS total_assignable_area,
  NULL AS total_rooms,
  NULL AS total_organizations,
  NULL AS ownership_type,
  NULL AS sector_rank
FROM ranked_buildings

ORDER BY
  -- order sectors alphabetically, with their building rows ordered by rank, subtotal after buildings, and grand total last
  CASE WHEN campus_sector = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 'ZZZ_GRAND_TOTAL' ELSE campus_sector END,
  CASE WHEN building_name = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  sector_rank

rows.question: For each department, list the name of the department, the title of the TIP material associated with the department, author, ISBN, library term code, and whether it is available in the library reserves ('Available in Library' if yes and 'Not Available in Library' otherwise), the total number of instructors per library book for the department, the total number of materials available in the library for the department, and the total number of available materials across all departments.

WITH dept_list_with_names AS (
  SELECT
    `fac_organization`.`ORGANIZATION_ID` AS `ORG_ID`,
    `fac_organization`.`HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME`
  FROM `fac_organization`
)
SELECT
  d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  m.TITLE AS TIP_TITLE,
  m.AUTHOR AS AUTHOR,
  m.ISBN AS ISBN,
  td.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
    WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
      AND lrm.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
  ) THEN 'Available in Library' ELSE 'Not Available in Library' END AS LIBRARY_AVAILABILITY,
  -- distinct instructors for this material (per book) for the department/term
  IFNULL((
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY))
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
    JOIN library_course_instructor lci
      ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
    WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
      AND lrm.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
  ), 0) AS INSTRUCTORS_PER_BOOK,
  -- total materials available in library for this department
  (

WITH owned_non_subdivision_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_ID,
    f.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    f.DATE_BUILT,
    f.DATE_OCCUPIED
  FROM fclt_building f
  WHERE f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND (f.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR f.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER = '')
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_ID,
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    DATE_BUILT,
    DATE_OCCUPIED,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR DATE_BUILT = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'))
    END AS built_year_num,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR DATE_BUILT = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      ELSE CAST(YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS CHAR)
    END AS built_year_display,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED IS NULL OR DATE_OCCUPIED = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      ELSE CAST(YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS CHAR)
    END AS occ_year_display
  FROM owned_non_subdivision_buildings
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CASE WHEN built_year_num IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS built_year_null_flag
  FROM parsed p
),
with_rownums AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY o.built_year_null_flag ASC, o.built_year_num ASC, o.BUILDING_NUMBER ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM ordered o
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    w.*,
    LAG(w.built_year_display) OVER (
      ORDER BY w.built_year_null_flag ASC, w.built_year_num ASC, w.BUILDING_NUMBER ASC
    ) AS prev_built_year_display
  FROM with_rownums w
),
main_rows AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN prev_built_year_display IS NOT NULL
           AND prev_built_year_display = built_year_display THEN ''
      ELSE built_year_display
    END AS construction_start_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    occ_year_display AS initial_occupancy_year,
    built_year_null_flag,
    built_year_num,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS ordering_building_number,
    rn
  FROM with_prev
)
SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year
FROM main_rows
ORDER BY built_year_null_flag ASC, built_year_num ASC, ordering_building_number ASC

UNION ALL

SELECT
  NULL AS construction_start_year,
  CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings') AS building_number,
  NULL AS initial_occupancy_year
FROM parsed
ORDER BY
  -- ensure the total row comes last: place NULL built_year first in sort, so we sort by a constant to push UNION total to end
  CASE WHEN construction_start_year IS NULL AND building_number LIKE '%Buildings' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  /* for the main rows use the same ordering as above */
  CASE WHEN construction_start_year = '' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END,
  building_number

rows.question: Group all buildings at MIT into either owned or leased. For each group, state the ownership type, usage type, number of buildings, gross square footage, number of rooms, and the number of associated organizations. Display the ownership type only if it differs from the previous row. Include subtotals for each group and a grand total across all groups. WITH norm_building_ownership_usage AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.SITE,
    CASE
      WHEN fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE)) LIKE '%own%' THEN 'Owned'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE)) LIKE '%lease%' THEN 'Leased'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE)) IN ('owned','own','owner') THEN 'Owned'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE)) IN ('leased','lease','lessee') THEN 'Leased'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS OWNERSHIP,
    CASE
      WHEN fb.BUILDING_USE IS NULL OR TRIM(fb.BUILDING_USE) = '' THEN 'Unknown'
      ELSE TRIM(fb.BUILDING_USE)
    END AS MAJOR_USE,
    fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA
  FROM fac_building fb
  WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT'
    AND (fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR TRIM(fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) = '')
),
-- Aggregate per building (keep key columns so results remain joinable)
agg_building_level_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    nb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    nb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    nb.OWNERSHIP,
    nb.MAJOR_USE,
    ROUND(IFNULL(nb.EXT_GROSS_AREA,0)) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS ORG_COUNT
  FROM norm_building_ownership_usage nb
  LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = nb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY

    nb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    nb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    nb.OWNERSHIP,
    nb.MAJOR_USE,
    nb.EXT_GROSS_AREA
),
-- Summary rows for ownership+usage, ownership subtotals, and grand total
summary_rows AS (

  SELECT
    ab.OWNERSHIP AS ownership_type,
    ab.MAJOR_USE AS usage_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS number_of_buildings,
    SUM(ab.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS gross_sq_ft_unformatted,
    SUM(ab.ROOM_COUNT) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(ab.ORG_COUNT) AS number_of_associated_organizations,
    1 AS section_order,
    CASE WHEN ab.OWNERSHIP = 'Owned' THEN 1 WHEN ab.OWNERSHIP = 'Leased' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS own_order,
    ab.MAJOR_USE AS usage_order
  FROM agg_building_level_metrics ab
  GROUP BY ab.OWNERSHIP, ab.MAJOR_USE

  UNION ALL

  -- subtotal per ownership
  SELECT
    '' AS ownership_type,
    '' AS usage_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS number_of_buildings,
    SUM(ab.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS gross_sq_ft_unformatted,
    SUM(ab.ROOM_COUNT) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(ab.ORG_COUNT) AS number_of_associated_organizations,

  SELECT

  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER NOT LIKE '%-%'

rows.question: For each organization except Cambridge-MIT Institute, list its ID, number, level, formatted name according to level (if level is 2, there should be 1 space before the name, if level is 3, there should be 2 space before the name, up to level 6), whether it is assignable ('ASSIGNABLE' if assignable, 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' otherwise), total area, number of rooms, and average room area. Area and number of rooms should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH organizations_base AS (
  SELECT
    fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fo.ASSIGNABLE AS ASSIGNABLE
  FROM fac_organization fo
  WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_ID) <> ''
),
organization_area_agg AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
    SUM(fr.AREA) AS TOTAL_AREA,
    COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS NUMBER_OF_ROOMS
  FROM fclt_rooms fr
  GROUP BY fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
),
organization_display_prep AS (
  SELECT
    ob.ORGANIZATION_ID,
    ob.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
    ob.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
    ob.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    -- normalize assignable: treat '1' or values that indicate truth as ASSIGNABLE, else NON-ASSIGNABLE
    CASE
      WHEN ob.ASSIGNABLE IS NULL THEN 'NON-ASSIGNABLE'
      WHEN TRIM(ob.ASSIGNABLE) = '' THEN 'NON-ASSIGNABLE'
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(ob.ASSIGNABLE)) IN ('1','Y','YES','T','TRUE') THEN 'ASSIGNABLE'
      ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE'
    END AS ASSIGNABILITY,
    -- compute leading spaces = (level - 1) capped to max 5; if level not numeric treat as 0
    CONCAT(
      SPACE(
        GREATEST(
          0,
          LEAST(
            5,
            CASE
              WHEN ob.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+' THEN CAST(ob.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS SIGNED) - 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          )
        )
      ),
      ob.ORGANIZATION_NAME
    ) AS FORMATTED_ORGANIZATION_NAME
  FROM organizations_base ob
)
SELECT
  d.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
  d.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  d.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  d.FORMATTED_ORGANIZATION_NAME AS FORMATTED_ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  d.ASSIGNABILITY AS ASSIGNABILITY,
  -- Rounded total area and formatted with commas; treat NULL as 0 per requirement for totals
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(a.TOTAL_AREA, 0)), 0) AS TOTAL_AREA,
  -- Rounded number of rooms and formatted; treat NULL as 0
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(a.NUMBER_OF_ROOMS, 0)), 0) AS NUMBER_OF_ROOMS,
  -- Average computed using the rounded TOTAL_AREA divided by rounded NUMBER_OF_ROOMS.
  -- If rounded number_of_rooms = 0 then produce NULL.
  CASE
    WHEN ROUND(COALESCE(a.NUMBER_OF_ROOMS, 0)) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE FORMAT(
           ROUND(
             ROUND(COALESCE(a.TOTAL_AREA, 0)) / NULLIF(ROUND(COALESCE(a.NUMBER_OF_ROOMS, 0)), 0)
           ), 0
         )
  END AS AVERAGE_ROOM_AREA
FROM organization_display_prep d

  ON d.ORGANIZATION_ID = a.ORGANIZATION_ID
WHERE d.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'

rows.question: List each building key and floor key within the department of facilities, the number of rooms, total area, average area per floor, building name, access level, zip code, and city. Include subtotals for each building and a grand total across all buildings. The subtotals and grand total should not include zip code or city. Numbers of rooms and area should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_rooms_rows AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY AS ROOM_KEY,
    fr.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.AREA AS AREA,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME
  FROM fac_rooms fr
),
building_floor_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    f.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    f.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
    -- prefer EXT_GROSS_AREA if present, otherwise ASSIGNABLE_AREA + NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
    COALESCE(f.EXT_GROSS_AREA,
             (COALESCE(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA,0) + COALESCE(f.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,0))
    ) AS TOTAL_AREA,
    COALESCE(r.num_rooms, 0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
    f.ACCESS_LEVEL AS FLOOR_ACCESS_LEVEL
  FROM fac_floor f
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      BUILDING_KEY,
      FLOOR_KEY,
      COUNT(*) AS num_rooms
    FROM fac_rooms
    WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
      AND FLOOR_KEY IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR_KEY
  ) r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = f.BUILDING_KEY
   AND r.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY
  WHERE f.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND f.FLOOR_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
-- only building+floor combinations that have at least one room assigned to DP OF FACILITIES
filtered_bfa AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bfa.BUILDING_KEY, bfa.FLOOR_KEY, bfa.TOTAL_AREA, bfa.NUM_ROOMS, bfa.FLOOR_ACCESS_LEVEL
  FROM building_floor_aggregates bfa
  JOIN fac_rooms_rows rr
    ON rr.BUILDING_KEY = bfa.BUILDING_KEY
   AND rr.FLOOR_KEY = bfa.FLOOR_KEY
  WHERE rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'
),
-- pick one address row per building (first by BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY) to get city/zip
building_address_one AS (
  SELECT
    ba.BUILDING_KEY,
    ba.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE,
    ba.CITY AS CITY
  FROM fac_building_address ba
  JOIN (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY, MIN(BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY) AS BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY
    FROM fac_building_address
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
  ) ba_min USING (BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY)
),
-- bring building level info
building_info AS (
  SELECT
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS BUILDING_ACCESS_LEVEL
  FROM fac_building b
),
-- detail rows annotated with building info
detail_rows AS (
  SELECT
    fb.BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.FLOOR_KEY,
    fb.NUM_ROOMS,
    fb.TOTAL_AREA,
    fb.FLOOR_ACCESS_LEVEL,
    bi.BUILDING_NAME,
    COALESCE(bi.BUILDING_ACCESS_LEVEL, fb.FLOOR_ACCESS_LEVEL) AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
    ba.POSTAL_CODE,
    ba.CITY
  FROM filtered_bfa fb
  LEFT JOIN building_info bi ON bi.BUILDING_KEY = fb.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN building_address_one ba ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.BUILDING_KEY
)
-- main select: detail rows, then subtotals per building, then grand total
SELECT
  dr.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  dr.FLOOR_KEY AS floor_key,
  FORMAT(ROUND(dr.NUM_ROOMS),0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(dr.TOTAL_AREA),0) AS total_area,
  FORMAT(ROUND(
    dr.TOTAL_AREA
    / NULLIF(COUNT(dr.FLOOR_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY dr.BUILDING_KEY),0)
  ),0) AS average_area_per_floor,
  dr.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  dr.ACCESS_LEVEL AS access_level,
  dr.POSTAL_CODE AS zip_code,
  dr.CITY AS city,
  'DETAIL' AS row_type
FROM detail_rows dr

UNION ALL

-- subtotals per building
SELECT
  fbsum.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  'SUBTOTAL' AS floor_key,
  FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(fbsum.NUM_ROOMS)),0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(fbsum.TOTAL_AREA)),0) AS total_area,
  FORMAT(ROUND(
    SUM(fbsum.TOTAL_AREA)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fbsum.FLOOR_KEY),0)
  ),0) AS average_area_per_floor,
  NULL AS building_name,
  NULL AS access_level,
  NULL AS zip_code,
  NULL AS city,
  'SUBTOTAL' AS row_type
FROM detail_rows fbsum
GROUP BY fbsum.BUILDING_KEY

UNION ALL

-- grand total
SELECT
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS building_key,
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS floor_key,
  FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(gt.NUM_ROOMS)),0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(gt.TOTAL_AREA)),0) AS total_area,
  FORMAT(ROUND(
    SUM(gt.TOTAL_AREA)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT gt.BUILDING_KEY),0)
  ),0) AS average_area_per_floor,
  NULL AS building_name,
  NULL AS access_level,
  NULL AS zip_code,
  NULL AS city,
  'GRAND_TOTAL' AS row_type
FROM detail_rows gt

ORDER BY
  -- ensure detail rows per building first, then subtotal, and grand total last
  CASE
    WHEN building_key = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 3
    WHEN row_type = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END,
  building_name ASC,
  building_key ASC,
  CASE WHEN row_type = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  floor_key ASC

rows.question: For each course in the current term, list the department, school, course number, subject title, total number of enrolled students, term code, and count of distinct catalog ISBNs. Add a summary row at the bottom showing the total number of students and distinct catalog ISBNs for the current term in the format of ('TOTAL:', null, null, null, total number of students, null, number of distinct catalog ISBNs).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH current_academic_term_rows AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `IS_CURRENT_TERM`
  FROM `academic_terms_all`
  WHERE `IS_CURRENT_TERM` = 'Y'
),
course_offering_enrollment_by_term AS (
  SELECT
    `SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT,
    `COURSE_NUMBER` AS CATALOG_NBR,
    `TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` AS OFFERING_ID,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE` AS TITLE,
    COALESCE(`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`, 0) AS ENROLL_TOTAL
  FROM `subject_offered`
  WHERE `TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),
course_catalog_isbn_by_offering AS (
  SELECT
    dcc.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT,
    dcc.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS CATALOG_NBR,
    dcc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    dcc.`SECTION_ID` AS OFFERING_ID,
    td.`ISBN` AS CATALOG_ISBN
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog` dcc
  JOIN `tip_subject_offered` tso
    ON tso.`TERM_CODE` = dcc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`
   AND tso.`SUBJECT_ID` = dcc.`SUBJECT_ID`
  LEFT JOIN `tip_detail` td
    ON td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  -- preserve rows even when td.ISBN is NULL so COUNT(DISTINCT) works correctly
)
SELECT
  co.SUBJECT AS department,
  NULL AS school,
  co.CATALOG_NBR AS course_number,
  co.TITLE AS subject_title,
  co.ENROLL_TOTAL AS total_enrolled_students,
  cat.`TERM_CODE` AS term_code,
  COALESCE(isb.cnt_isbns, 0) AS distinct_catalog_isbn_count
FROM current_academic_term_rows cat
JOIN course_offering_enrollment_by_term co
  ON co.TERM_CODE = cat.`TERM_CODE`
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT,
    CATALOG_NBR,
    TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CATALOG_ISBN) AS cnt_isbns
  FROM course_catalog_isbn_by_offering
  GROUP BY SUBJECT, CATALOG_NBR, TERM_CODE
) isb
  ON isb.TERM_CODE = co.TERM_CODE
 AND isb.SUBJECT = co.SUBJECT
 AND isb.CATALOG_NBR = co.CATALOG_NBR

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL:' AS department,
  NULL AS school,
  NULL AS course_number,
  NULL AS subject_title,
  SUM(co.ENROLL_TOTAL) AS total_enrolled_students,
  NULL AS term_code,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CATALOG_ISBN)
    FROM course_catalog_isbn_by_offering cb
    JOIN current_academic_term_rows cat2
      ON cb.TERM_CODE = cat2.`TERM_CODE`
  ) AS distinct_catalog_isbn_count
FROM current_academic_term_rows cat
JOIN course_offering_enrollment_by_term co
  ON co.TERM_CODE = cat.`TERM_CODE`
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN department = 'TOTAL:' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  department, course_number

rows.question: For each IAP category, list its name, number of unique sessions, total number of attendees, active period (in the format of 'beginning term code-end term code'), the most common sponsor name, and the most common session start time. Include a grand total row showing the total number of sessions and attendees across all categories in the format of ('TOTAL', number of sessions, number of attendees, null, null, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- category list
iap_category_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AS CATEGORY_ID,
    IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME
  FROM iap_subject_category
),
-- per-session metrics derived from detail + session + sponsor
session_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    sd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AS CATEGORY_ID,
    sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS SESSION_ID,
    -- deterministic TERM_CODE per session (choose MIN if multiple / ignore empty)
    MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(sd.TERM_CODE), '')) AS TERM_CODE,
    -- attendees: count distinct person keys per session (treat null/empty as no person)
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(sd.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY), '')) AS ATTENDEES,
    -- pick the most common sponsor name for this session (from joined sponsor table), canonicalized
    (SELECT ss.SPONSOR_NAME
     FROM iap_subject_sponsor ss
     JOIN iap_subject_detail sd2
       ON sd2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
      AND sd2.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
      AND sd2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = sd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
     WHERE ss.SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ss.SPONSOR_NAME) <> ''
     GROUP BY ss.SPONSOR_NAME
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ss.SPONSOR_NAME
     LIMIT 1
    ) AS TOP_SPONSOR_NAME,
    -- pick the most common session start time (from session table) for this session/category
    (SELECT s.SESSION_START_TIME
     FROM iap_subject_session s
     JOIN iap_subject_detail sd3
       ON sd3.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
      AND sd3.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = sd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
      AND sd3.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
     WHERE s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.SESSION_START_TIME) <> ''
     GROUP BY s.SESSION_START_TIME
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.SESSION_START_TIME
     LIMIT 1
    ) AS TOP_START_TIME
  FROM iap_subject_detail sd
  WHERE sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) <> ''
  GROUP BY sd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
),
-- aggregates per category
category_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    c.CATEGORY_ID,
    -- count unique sessions
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.SESSION_ID) AS UNIQUE_SESSIONS,
    -- total attendees is sum of session-level attendees
    COALESCE(SUM(sm.ATTENDEES), 0) AS TOTAL_ATTENDEES,
    -- active period: min and max TERM_CODE across sessions for the category
    MIN(sm.TERM_CODE) AS MIN_TERM_CODE,
    MAX(sm.TERM_CODE) AS MAX_TERM_CODE,
    -- most common sponsor name across all session detail rows for the category
    (SELECT ss.SPONSOR_NAME
     FROM iap_subject_sponsor ss
     JOIN iap_subject_detail sd
       ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
      AND sd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.CATEGORY_ID
     WHERE ss.SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ss.SPONSOR_NAME) <> ''
     GROUP BY ss.SPONSOR_NAME
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ss.SPONSOR_NAME
     LIMIT 1
    ) AS MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR,
    -- most common session start time across sessions for the category
    (SELECT s.SESSION_START_TIME
     FROM iap_subject_session s
     JOIN iap_subject_detail sd
       ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
      AND sd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.CATEGORY_ID
     WHERE s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.SESSION_START_TIME) <> ''
     GROUP BY s.SESSION_START_TIME
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.SESSION_START_TIME
     LIMIT 1
    ) AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME
  FROM iap_category_lookup c
  LEFT JOIN session_metrics sm
    ON sm.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID
  GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_ID
)
-- final select: one row per category, plus TOTAL row
SELECT
  icl.CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  COALESCE(ca.UNIQUE_SESSIONS, 0) AS NUM_SESSIONS,
  COALESCE(ca.TOTAL_ATTENDEES, 0) AS TOTAL_ATTENDEES,
  CASE
    WHEN ca.MIN_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(ca.MIN_TERM_CODE, '-', ca.MAX_TERM_CODE)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS ACTIVE_PERIOD,
  ca.MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR AS MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR,
  ca.MOST_COMMON_START_TIME AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME
FROM iap_category_lookup icl
LEFT JOIN category_aggregates ca
  ON icl.CATEGORY_ID = ca.CATEGORY_ID

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  SUM(COALESCE(ca.UNIQUE_SESSIONS, 0)) AS NUM_SESSIONS,
  SUM(COALESCE(ca.TOTAL_ATTENDEES, 0)) AS TOTAL_ATTENDEES,
  NULL AS ACTIVE_PERIOD,
  NULL AS MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR,
  NULL AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME
FROM iap_category_lookup icl
LEFT JOIN category_aggregates ca
  ON icl.CATEGORY_ID = ca.CATEGORY_ID

ORDER BY
  (CATEGORY_NAME = 'TOTAL') ASC,
  CATEGORY_NAME ASC

rows.question: For each building type, list the name of the building type, the number of buildings that are not subdivisions, number of employees, number of unique building street address, number of unique city, number of unique state, number of unique postal code, and average gross square footage per employee. For building type of 'resident', display it as 'RESIDENTIAL'. Include a grand total across all building types (the corresponding type field is 'TOTAL').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_addresses_street AS (
  SELECT
    fba.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE AS ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
    TRIM(CONCAT(
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
      CASE
        WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER <> '' AND fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX)
        WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX <> '' THEN fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX
        ELSE ''
      END,
      CASE WHEN fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL) ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_NAME) ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_SUFFIX <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_SUFFIX) ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL) ELSE '' END
    )) AS ADDRESS_LINE_1,
    fba.CITY AS CITY,
    fba.STATE AS STATE,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE
  FROM fac_building_address fba
  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
building_base AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS BUILDING_TYPE,
    CASE WHEN fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENT' ELSE fb.BUILDING_TYPE END AS BUILDING_TYPE_CANONICAL,
    CASE WHEN fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_SUBDIVISION,
    COALESCE(fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM fac_building fb
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE IS NOT NULL
),
-- per-building address distinct counts (only street purpose included in CTE)
building_address_counts AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ADDRESS_LINE_1) AS unique_street_address_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CITY) AS unique_city_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT STATE) AS unique_state_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT POSTAL_CODE) AS unique_postal_code_count
  FROM building_addresses_street
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
),
-- per-building employee counts: count distinct MIT_ID per building (employee-directory.OFFICE_LOCATION maps to BUILDING_NUMBER)
building_employee_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ed.MIT_ID) AS employee_count
  FROM building_base b
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  GROUP BY b.BUILDING_KEY
),
-- per-building combined metrics
building_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    bb.BUILDING_KEY,
    bb.BUILDING_TYPE,
    bb.BUILDING_TYPE_CANONICAL,
    bb.IS_SUBDIVISION,
    bb.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    COALESCE(ac.unique_street_address_count, 0) AS unique_street_address_count,
    COALESCE(ac.unique_city_count, 0) AS unique_city_count,
    COALESCE(ac.unique_state_count, 0) AS unique_state_count,
    COALESCE(ac.unique_postal_code_count, 0) AS unique_postal_code_count,
    COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count
  FROM building_base bb
  LEFT JOIN building_address_counts ac ON ac.BUILDING_KEY = bb.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN building_employee_counts ec ON ec.BUILDING_KEY = bb.BUILDING_KEY
)
-- per-type aggregates plus total row
SELECT
  building_type,
  non_subdivision_building_count,
  employee_count,
  unique_street_address_count,
  unique_city_count,
  unique_state_count,
  unique_postal_code_count,
  CASE
    WHEN employee_count = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(total_gross_sqft / employee_count, 2)
  END AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM (
  -- per-building-type aggregates (excluding subdivisions)
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE BUILDING_TYPE END AS building_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_subdivision_building_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN employee_count ELSE 0 END) AS employee_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN unique_street_address_count ELSE 0 END) AS unique_street_address_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN unique_city_count ELSE 0 END) AS unique_city_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN unique_state_count ELSE 0 END) AS unique_state_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN unique_postal_code_count ELSE 0 END) AS unique_postal_code_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN COALESCE(BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_gross_sqft
  FROM building_metrics
  GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE

  UNION ALL

  -- grand total across all building types (excluding subdivisions)
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS building_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_subdivision_building_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN employee_count ELSE 0 END) AS employee_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN unique_street_address_count ELSE 0 END) AS unique_street_address_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN unique_city_count ELSE 0 END) AS unique_city_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN unique_state_count ELSE 0 END) AS unique_state_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN unique_postal_code_count ELSE 0 END) AS unique_postal_code_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUBDIVISION = 0 THEN COALESCE(BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_gross_sqft
  FROM building_metrics
) t
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN building_type = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  building_type

rows.question: List each organization's break group, ID, name, and formatted name according to its level, along with whether its members are emeritus or non-emeritus. Also, include the organization number, level, employer count, and hierarchy type for each organization. Exclude organizations '139' and '250'. Sort the results by hierarchy type and ensure totals for employer counts are displayed.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH organization_hierarchy_labels AS (
  SELECT
    `ORGANIZATION_ID` AS ORG_ID,
    `ORGANIZATION_LEVEL` AS ORG_LEVEL,
    mdh.`HIERARCHY_TYPE` AS HIERARCHY_TYPE
  FROM fac_organization fo
  LEFT JOIN master_dept_hierarchy mdh
    ON fo.`D_CODE` = mdh.`DLC_CODE`
),
organization_emeritus_flag AS (
  -- map org (by HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE which in roster corresponds to an org label) to emeritus flags
  SELECT
    `HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE` AS ORG_ID,
    `EMERITUS_STATUS` AS EMERITUS_FLAG
  FROM hr_faculty_roster
  WHERE `HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE`, `EMERITUS_STATUS`
),
organization_employer_counts AS (
  -- count distinct MIT_ID per organization title (HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE)
  SELECT
    `HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE` AS ORG_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `MIT_ID`) AS employer_count
  FROM hr_faculty_roster
  WHERE `HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE`
),
organization_core AS (
  SELECT
    `ORGANIZATION_ID` AS ORG_ID,
    `HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    `ORGANIZATION_LEVEL` AS ORG_LEVEL,
    `ORGANIZATION_NUMBER` AS ORG_NUMBER,
    `COURSE` AS HIERARCHY_TYPE,
    `ORGANIZATION_SORT` AS BREAK_GROUP,
    `ORGANIZATION_NAME` AS ORGANIZATION_NAME
  FROM fac_organization
)
SELECT
  oc.BREAK_GROUP                                      AS BREAK_GROUP,
  oc.ORG_ID                                          AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME                                AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  CASE
    WHEN oc.ORG_LEVEL = '1' THEN oc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
    WHEN oc.ORG_LEVEL IN ('2','3') THEN CONCAT(oc.ORG_NUMBER, ' - ', oc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME)
    ELSE CONCAT(oc.ORG_NUMBER, ' | ', oc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME)
  END                                                 AS FORMATTED_NAME,
  CASE WHEN oef.has_emeritus = 1 THEN 'Emeritus' ELSE 'Non-Emeritus' END AS EMERITUS_STATUS_LABEL,
  oc.ORG_NUMBER                                      AS ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  oc.ORG_LEVEL                                       AS LEVEL,
  COALESCE(oec.employer_count,0)                     AS EMPLOYER_COUNT,
  COALESCE(ohl.HIERARCHY_TYPE, oc.HIERARCHY_TYPE)    AS HIERARCHY_TYPE
FROM organization_core oc
LEFT JOIN organization_employer_counts oec
  ON oec.ORG_ID = oc.ORG_ID
LEFT JOIN organization_hierarchy_labels ohl
  ON ohl.ORG_ID = oc.ORG_ID
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    ORG_ID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN EMERITUS_FLAG = 'Emeritus' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_emeritus
  FROM organization_emeritus_flag
  GROUP BY ORG_ID
) oef
  ON oef.ORG_ID = oc.ORG_ID
WHERE oc.ORG_ID NOT IN ('139','250')

UNION ALL

SELECT
  NULL                                                 AS BREAK_GROUP,
  NULL                                                 AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
  'TOTAL'                                              AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  'Total Employers'                                    AS FORMATTED_NAME,
  'All'                                                AS EMERITUS_STATUS_LABEL,
  NULL                                                 AS ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  NULL                                                 AS LEVEL,
  SUM(COALESCE(oec.employer_count,0))                  AS EMPLOYER_COUNT,
  NULL                                                 AS HIERARCHY_TYPE
FROM organization_core oc
LEFT JOIN organization_employer_counts oec
  ON oec.ORG_ID = oc.ORG_ID
WHERE oc.ORG_ID NOT IN ('139','250')

ORDER BY
  COALESCE(HIERARCHY_TYPE, '') ASC,
  COALESCE(BREAK_GROUP, '') ASC,
  COALESCE(ORGANIZATION_ID, '') ASC

rows.question: For each course, list its title, name of the building of the course location, duration (in terms of days), and a running average of the duration (in terms of days) using a window of two preceding and two following courses (partitioned by academic year and sorted by course start date).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH rank_latest_fclt_building_by_key AS (
SELECT
  fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  fclt_building.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fclt_building.BUILDING_NAME,
  fclt_building.ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  fclt_building.EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  fclt_building.SITE,
  fclt_building.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  fclt_building.LATITUDE_WGS,
  fclt_building.LONGITUDE_WGS,
  fclt_building.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
    ORDER BY (fclt_building.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NULL), fclt_building.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC
  ) AS row_rank
FROM fclt_building
),
building_lookup_by_key_or_number AS (
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN rank_latest_fclt_building_by_key f
  ON f.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER OR f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY OR fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
)
SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building,
  DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(c.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), STR_TO_DATE(c.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS duration_days,
  AVG(DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(c.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), STR_TO_DATE(c.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'))) 
    OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR
      ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(c.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS running_avg_duration_days
FROM (
  SELECT
    SECTION_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MEET_PLACE,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    NULL AS START_DATE,
    NULL AS END_DATE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    SECTION_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MEET_PLACE,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    NULL AS START_DATE,
    NULL AS END_DATE
  FROM drupal_course_catalog
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    NULL AS SECTION_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    NULL AS MEET_PLACE,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    NULL AS START_DATE,
    NULL AS END_DATE
  FROM cis_course_catalog
) c
JOIN building_lookup_by_key_or_number b
  ON c.MEET_PLACE = b.BUILDING_KEY OR c.MEET_PLACE = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
WHERE
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL

course_offerings_with_meet_place AS (
SELECT

  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`,
  -- canonical course identifier: preserve source columns (no derivation). COURSE_ID is not stored in this table;
  -- expose COURSE_ID by passing through SECTION_ID as course-level identifier only if COURSE_ID exists in source.
  -- Because requirement mandates the output columns come from course_catalog_subject_offered, and COURSE_ID isn't a column there,
  -- join is needed. There is no separate COURSE table in scope, so create COURSE_ID as concatenation of SUBJECT_CODE and SUBJECT_NUMBER
  -- only as a canonical identifier (not substituting a stored COURSE_ID). However the developer instructions forbid re-deriving a stored value;
  -- COURSE_ID does not exist in the schema for this table, so we will create a COURSE_ID derived from existing stored columns SUBJECT_CODE and SUBJECT_NUMBER.
  -- Carry through SECTION_ID and TERM_ID mapped to existing columns.
  CONCAT(

dim_academic_terms_current AS (

win_running_room_area_by_building AS (

course_name_order_with_neighbors AS (

academic_terms_primary_dates AS (

rows.question: For email lists with names starting with e (case insensitive), containing 10 to 20 members inclusive, and where over 75% are computer science students, provide the list name, owner, and member count.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_owners AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    mlo.OWNER AS owner
  FROM moira_list_owner mlo
  JOIN moira_list ml
    ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
person_department AS (
  SELECT
    msd.FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE AS username,
    msd.DEPARTMENT AS department
  FROM mit_student_directory AS msd
  WHERE msd.FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT
    opc.KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE AS username,
    opc.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD AS department
  FROM opa_person_current AS opc
  WHERE opc.KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT
    se.KRB_NAME AS username,
    se.ORGANIZATION AS department
  FROM se_person AS se
  WHERE se.KRB_NAME IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  stats.member_count
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pd.department = '6' THEN d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER END) AS cs_member_count
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  LEFT JOIN person_department pd
    ON d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = pd.username
  GROUP BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) AS stats
  ON stats.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN moira_list_owners mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = '1' -- mailing list system = MOIRA; adjust value if ML uses 'Y'/'true'
  AND LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'e%'
  AND stats.member_count BETWEEN 10 AND 20
  AND (stats.cs_member_count * 1.0 / stats.member_count) > 0.75
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For students with last names starting with K, list their names, the phone numbers of departments they belong to, total number of mailing lists each student is in, and the average size of the mailing lists each student is in.

WITH moira_list_sizes AS (
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS listname,
  COALESCE(mld.COUNTER, 0) AS detail_count,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
  mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
FROM

LEFT JOIN

    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mld.COUNTER,
  mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
  mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
)
SELECT
  m.FULL_NAME AS student_name,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(m.OFFICE_PHONE,'') SEPARATOR '; ') AS department_phone_numbers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS total_mailing_lists,

FROM mit_student_directory m
LEFT JOIN moira_list_detail d
